title: Project Manager for the EuroTeQ Pathway Project - Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs
employer: DTU Afdelingen for Uddannelse og Studerende
description:
Would you like to contribute to the development of DTU’s educational offers? Do you want to help shape the future of European higher education and collaborate with colleagues and partners across Europe?

The Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs (AUS) at DTU is looking for a proactive Project Manager to join the Office of International Education as Project Manager for the EuroTeQ Pathway Project, a newly awarded 24-month EU-funded project focused on the European Degree Label.

In this role you will help translate new European educational frameworks into practice and support their implementation across DTU, contributing to the continued development and internationalisation of DTU’s educational portfolio.

As Project Manager, you will be at the centre of this work, coordinating partners across Europe while taking responsibility for key training, stakeholder engagement, and implementation activities. Through your work, you will help strengthen DTU’s capacity to engage in new forms of European educational collaboration and turn emerging opportunities into lasting value for DTU and its students.

The job
You will join the Office of International Education, as part of the Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs (AUS), which has approximately 120 employees and is responsible for developing and supporting DTU’s educational processes, with a strong focus on our students.

As our new Project Manager, you will coordinate the EuroTeQ Pathway Project from planning and reporting, to partner coordination and delivery of key activities.

This is not a conventional project management position. You will also take an active role in developing the project’s content, leading training and stakeholder activities, and strengthening DTU’s understanding of the European Degree Label and its implications in a Danish context. You will work closely with consortium partners and DTU colleagues, while taking responsibility for the quality and delivery of the project activities within your remit.

The role offers an opportunity to combine international project leadership with educational development and stakeholder engagement, while helping translate European developments into value for DTU and its educational portfolio. We anticipate 5-10 travel days a year.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Coordinate the overall project plan, including timelines, milestones, budget, risks, and dependencies across the four work packages.
  • Coordinate consortium partners and EU project reporting, ensuring timely delivery of project outputs and milestones
  • Lead the development and implementation of key project activities, including training, communication, and stakeholder events.
  • Organise and facilitate the national stakeholder workshop and contribute to the project’s national roadmap.
  • Build and maintain relationships with national and international stakeholders across higher education, quality assurance, and policy.
  • Strengthen DTU’s institutional understanding of the European Degree Label and translate relevant project outcomes into value for DTU’s educational development.

Knowledge of Danish is not required for the position. However, as much of DTU's internal administration is conducted in Danish, you should expect to encounter Danish in larger meetings and institutional contexts.

Our expectations of you
You have a university degree and, ideally, experience from the education sector or another publicly funded organization, with experience in project management.

We would like you to:
  • Have a proactive and self-driven approach, with a strong sense of ownership. You take initiative, move activities forward independently, and know when to seek input and involve relevant colleagues
  • Seek out effective collaboration and cross-functional coordination
  • Be able to follow and devise formalised processes
  • Are able to familiarise yourself with study regulations and the legal framework in the education sector, for example, Knowledge of European higher education, particularly quality assurance, accreditation, and/or cross-border regulatory frameworks. Familiarity with frameworks such as the European Approach for Quality Assurance of Joint Programmes or EQAR would be an advantage.
  • Experience planning and delivering stakeholder events, from initial concept and logistics through to facilitation, delivery, and follow-up.

What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international atmosphere with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. In the area of technical and natural sciences, DTU is one of the leading research and education institutions in Europe.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Monday, 12 October 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Director of International Education Morten Overgaard, +45 2112 9850.

For specific questions about the tasks for this role or the broader project, please contact International Programme Manager Paige Daly, +45 2365 2213.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Operations Planner Wanted for Staffing Agency
description:
Operations Planner Wanted for Staffing Agency

Are you highly organised, good with people, and able to keep a cool head when the phone rings and the plan suddenly changes?

We are looking for an engaged and structured Operations Planner to play a central role in the day-to-day operations of our staffing agency.

Your main responsibility will be to ensure that our clients get the right temporary employees, in the right place, at the right time. You will therefore have close contact with both clients and temporary employees and play an important role in ensuring that daily staffing requirements are met.

Your Responsibilities

  • Planning and coordinating shifts

  • Booking and assigning temporary employees

  • Communicating with clients about their staffing needs

  • Daily contact with temporary employees by phone, email, and messaging

  • Handling sickness, cancellations, and last-minute changes

  • Following up on attendance and staffing

  • Maintaining shift schedules and information in our systems

  • Ensuring a high level of service for both clients and temporary employees

  • Continuously improving planning processes and workflows

Who Are You?

We are looking for someone who can create structure in a working environment where things can change quickly.

You work independently, take responsibility, and are not afraid to pick up the phone and find a solution. At the same time, you understand that good communication and strong relationships are essential in the staffing industry.

Experience from a staffing agency, recruitment, workforce planning, shift scheduling, customer service, transportation, logistics, or other operational planning is an advantage. However, the most important thing is that you have the right drive, flexibility, and ability to maintain an overview.

We expect you to:

  • Be structured and good at planning

  • Be able to manage multiple tasks at the same time

  • Be service-minded and professional

  • Be a strong communicator with different types of people

  • Be able to make quick decisions and find solutions

  • Be comfortable using IT and digital planning systems

  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment with responsibility

We Offer

A challenging and important role in a growing staffing agency, where you will have significant influence on our daily operations.

You will become part of a team where service, collaboration, and finding quick solutions are a natural part of everyday work.

Location: Copenhagen
Working hours: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
Start date: As soon as possible
Salary: Based on qualifications

title: Industrislagter til Udbening i Blans
description:
Erfarne industrislagtere til udbening søges til Blans

 

Har du et stabilt og omstillingsparat mindset? Er du klar til at gøre en indsats, og kan du kombinere din positive indstilling med et godt håndelag? Hvis ja, så kan det være, at vi søger netop dig til vores udbeningsafdeling.

 

Om jobbet:
På vores slagteri i Blans søger vi dygtige slagteriarbejdere til at styrke vores udbeningsafdelinger, både på dag- og aftenhold. Slagteriet beskæftiger 1.100 medarbejdere og håndterer hver uge hele 62.000 grise.

Som en del af vores team i skærestuen vil du indgå i et samarbejde, der bygger på stærke relationer og gode løsninger. Vi arbejder på akkord og vægter teamwork højt – både internt og med vores samarbejdspartnere.

 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver inkluderer:

  • Udbening af delstykker

  • Overholdelse af sikkerhedsprocedurer, hygiejnekrav og andre regler

  • Lettere, forfaldende arbejde efter behov

 

Arbejdstider:

Daghold: 40 timer om ugen, mandag til fredag, med opsparing af 3 timer ugentligt til hensættelse.
Aftenhold: 32 timer om ugen, mandag til fredag, med en rullende ugentlig fridag.
Vi tilbyder dig et spændende job i en international virksomhed, hvor der er fokus på udvikling og ambitiøse mål.

 

Din profil
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet slagter eller har erfaring fra en lignende stilling – dette er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

title: Kok med erfaring i pizza og kebab søges til Kebab & Chilis Pizza
description:

Om jobbet

Som kok hos Kebab & Chilis Pizza får du en alsidig arbejdsdag, hvor du kommer til at arbejde med forskellige dele af køkkenet. Det er vigtigt, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, bevare overblikket i travle perioder og samtidig samarbejde godt med dine kolleger.

Stillingen er særligt rettet mod en kok, der har praktisk erfaring med tilberedning af pizza og kebab, men du skal også være indstillet på at arbejde med restaurantens øvrige retter og almindelige køkkenopgaver.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være tilberedning og bagning af pizza, herunder klargøring af pizzadej, toppings og øvrige råvarer. Du vil desuden stå for klargøring, tilberedning og udskæring af kebab og shawarma samt tilberedning af dürüm, pitabrød, kebabretter, grillretter, kødretter og andre retter fra restaurantens menukort.

Som en del af den daglige drift skal du også forberede og klargøre råvarer, anrette og klargøre bestillinger samt sikre, at maden tilberedes korrekt og med ensartet kvalitet. Du vil desuden deltage i kontrol og korrekt opbevaring af råvarer og fødevarer samt den løbende planlægning og klargøring af køkkenets produktion.

Arbejdet omfatter også almindelig rengøring og oprydning i køkkenet. Du skal være med til at sikre, at arbejdsområder, køkkenudstyr og redskaber holdes rene og ordentlige, og at gældende regler om fødevaresikkerhed, hygiejne og egenkontrol overholdes.

Vi forventer af dig

Vi forventer, at du har relevant praktisk erfaring som kok eller fra arbejde i restaurant, pizzeria, kebabrestaurant eller lignende. Det er særligt vigtigt, at du har erfaring med tilberedning af pizza og kebab og kan varetage disse arbejdsopgaver selvstændigt.

Du skal kunne arbejde struktureret og effektivt, også når der er travlt, og du skal være fleksibel i forhold til de forskellige arbejdsopgaver, der opstår i løbet af arbejdsdagen. Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og samarbejdsvillig.

Vi tilbyder en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen i en restaurant med en varieret menu og en travl hverdag. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor der lægges vægt på samarbejde, kvalitet og god service.

title: Forsikrings- og risikostyringskonsulent
description:
Vil du sætte retning for forsikring og risikostyring i en stor kommunal organisation?

Har du solid forsikringsfaglig erfaring, stærke analytiske evner og blik for både skader, risici og forebyggelse? Så har vi en spændende mulighed til dig.

Ikast-Brande Kommune søger en forsikrings- og risikostyringskonsulent, som får ansvar for kommunens forsikringsområde og en central rolle i udviklingen af kommunens risikostyring. Stillingen er placeret i økonomiafdelingen som en del af konsulent- og analyseteamet.

Et bredt og komplekst forsikringsområde

Kommunens forsikringsprogram omfatter blandt andet bygning og løsøre, entrepriser, motoransvar, arbejdsskade, erhvervs- og produktansvar, specialansvar, rejse, kriminalitet samt kollektiv ulykkesforsikring. 

Da kommunen er selvforsikret på arbejdsskader, er håndteringen med disse naturligvis en stor del af arbejdsopgaverne.

Kommunen er endvidere selvforsikret på kaskoskade på biler og frivillig indsats.

Du bliver kommunens centrale faglige ressource og skal sikre, at forsikringsprogrammet løbende matcher organisationens behov og risikobillede.

Fra skadesbehandling til risikostyring

Du får en alsidig hverdag med både konkrete skader og risikostyring. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • administration og udvikling af kommunens forsikringsportefølje

  • behandling af skader – herunder arbejdsskader og ansvarsskader samt rådgivning om forsikrings- og erstatningsforhold

  • dialog og forhandling med forsikringsselskaber, mæglere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • vurdering og rådgivning om forsikringsbehov og risici, fx ved byggeprojekter og nye aktiviteter

  • analyse af skader og risici samt udvikling af forebyggende indsatser og beslutningsgrundlag

  • vi forventer, at du kan se ud over den enkelte skade: Hvad kan vi lære, og hvordan vi forebygger, at den sker igen.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant forsikringsfaglig eller juridisk uddannelse og flere års erfaring fra fx forsikringsselskab, forsikringsmægler, kommune eller en anden større organisation.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med skadesbehandling, arbejdsskade og selvforsikring, risikostyring, erstatningsret samt dialog med forsikringsselskaber og mæglere.

Som person er du selvstændig, struktureret, analytisk og relationsstærk. Du formidler komplekse problemstillinger klart, skaber tillid og finder løsninger, der fungerer i praksis. Du har faglig tyngde, men møder organisationen åbent og imødekommende.

En rolle med mulighed for at sætte dit præg

Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab i økonomiafdelingen og får en bred samarbejdsflade på tværs af kommunen. Vi ønsker at styrke den proaktive og forebyggende risikostyring, og du får mulighed for at udvikle området og skabe sammenhæng mellem forsikring, forebyggelse og drift. 
Du bliver en central del af kommunens velfungerende forsikringsteam og skal sikre, at forsikringsprogrammet løbende matcher organisationens behov og risikobillede.

Vi tilbyder

En selvstændig specialiststilling med stor faglig bredde, en bred kontaktflade, mulighed for at udvikle risikostyringen, fleksible arbejdsforhold og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og principperne for lokal løndannelse.

title: Associate Professor in ‘Experimental Nanooptics’.
description:
The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Nano Optics (www.sdu.dk/nano-optics) invites applications for an Associate Professor position in ‘Experimental Nano-Optics’. The starting date is Feb 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The successful candidate is expected to conduct cutting-edge experimental research within nano-optics involving advanced optical characterization of localized and propagating strongly enhanced and confined electromagnetic excitations with the state-of-the-art amplitude and phase-resolved near-field microscope available (NeaSpec). The near-field characterization is expected to be complemented with other optical characterization techniques as well as with performing advanced electromagnetic modelling. The candidate should have documented teaching experience at both BSc and MSc levels along with the corresponding teaching portfolio.

The application material should include a detailed motivation and an outline of the research activities that are to be pursued. In their applications, applicants should highlight their ten most significant journal publications, detailing also their author contributions. Applicants who wish to be considered should provide a link to a fully-updated ResearcherID (www.researcherid.com). The application material should also include detailed accounts on supervision and teaching experience.

The prospective candidates should have a Ph.D. degree in physics, preferably within nano-optics, and documented research experience in the aforementioned experimental techniques. They are expected to have a notable international profile, strong record of research publications, and demonstrated exceptional potential to excel in scientific research. We expect the candidate to actively engage in the development of academic research, conducting vigorous fund raising activities, and educational environment at the Centre for Nano Optics.

The candidate is expected to teach and instruct both graduate and undergraduet students as well as supervise bachelor and master projects. Furthermore, the candicate is expected to contribute actively to young-researcher education through supervision of Ph.D. students and postdoctorial researchers. 

For further information about the position and research infrastructure as well as Centre for Nano Optics, contact Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Read more on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger

Contact information
For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci. 

Further information about this position is available Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Please be aware that we will not accept any email applications, as all applications must be submitted through the SDU online recruitment system.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Research plan for the position in question (max. 2 pages). 
    Upload in the field called "Project description". 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, external funding etc.

  • Verified copies of official Certificates/Diplomas (BSc, MSc and PhD) 

  • List of publications with most relevant publications highlighted.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers, who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: 

Motivated application shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files of max 50 MB per file).

The application deadline is November 1st, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Read more and apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

title: Postdoc in Veterinary Microbiology
description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

Our research
The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

  • Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals.
  • Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.
For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

Your job
You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

Profile
We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

Essential experience and skills:

  • A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine
  • A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field
  • Previous postdoctoral experience
  • Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage
  • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills
  • Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students
  • Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects
  • Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis
  • Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Research experience in antimicrobial resistance
  • Experience in metagenomics
  • Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics
  • Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Questions
For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers
After the expiry date or applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Application deadline: 15 October 2026, 23.59 CEST.

Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

title: Industriteknikker eller tillært medarbejder
description:
OJM søger industriteknikker eller tillærte medarbejdere til CNC fræseafdeling (3x12 timer aften/nathold - onsdag til lørdag morgen)

Er du faglært eller har erfaring med CNC-fræsning, samt masser af godt humør, lysten til at gå forrest og gøre en forskel og derved være med til at vise vejen fremadrettet, har OJM A/S jobbet til dig.

Vi er i en rivende udvikling og har derfor behov for at udvide medarbejderstaben i vores fræseafdeling på et fast daghold

Som medarbejder i vores fræseafdeling vil du spille en vigtig rolle i den løbende produktion med at holde vores maskiner i kontinuerlig drift med konstant fokus på kvalitet, output, opstilling og forbedringer. Du vil blive en del af et team på 7-8 medarbejdere, hvor din faglige kunnen, indflydelse og god kommunikation er vigtige parametre. Vi er en mangfoldig arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til den enkelte, og hvor faglig og personlig udvikling samt personlige målsætninger prioriteres højt. 

Din profil  

Vi forventer, at du:

  • har en relevant erfaring inden for CNC-bearbejdning

  • erfaring med løbende produktion, gerne på følgende maskine typer

    • Mazak HCN6000, SW442BA

  • erfaring med robot håndteret maskiner/celler

  • erfaring med tegningslæsning, brug af div. måleudstyr mm.

  • besidder IT-færdigheder på brugerniveau

 Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • har erfaring med at arbejde på aften/nathold/weekend

  • har en analytisk tilgang til opgaverne og altid prøver at finde en optimal løsning

  • evner at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig at være en god holdspiller

  • er glad, positiv og udadvendt

  Vi tilbyder:

  • et spændende job med gode og selvstændige arbejdsvilkår

  • et godt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel og ordentlig omgangstone

  • gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold: 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes med udgangspunkt i en vurdering af din faglige kompetencer.

  • En fast weekendstilling på 16-17 timer om ugen

  • Fast arbejde hver lørdag og søndag

  • Firmabil til al kørsel i forbindelse med arbejdet

title: Norwegian or Swedish speaking insurance sales agent (Norwegian market)
description:
Do you like to challenge and are you fluent in Norwegian and/or Swedish and have a profound understanding for the Norwegian market?
- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Norwegian sales department at Nordiccom!

Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. Our Norwegian team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on our sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurance solutions to existing customers in the financial sector. All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone. It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.


Qualities we highly value from you:

- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone

- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people

- A competitive and result-oriented mindset

- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)

- Huge plus if you have experience working with tele sales/telemarketing from a previous job
 

What you can expect from us:

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city.

- Office located in the heart of Copenhagen

 

Who are we and what do we do?
Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

If this sounds interesting to you, please don't hesitate to send your resumé and an application marked "Norwegian sales agent".

title: Software Tester & Quality Specialist – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition
description:
Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Software Tester & Quality Specialist who likes to make a difference! 

Job description: 

As a Software Tester & Quality Specialist in the Quality Management team, you will work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers to help ensure the quality of Nordic RCC's systems and services.

We believe quality starts long before testing begins. Therefore, you will be involved early in the development process, helping teams identify risks, clarify requirements, and prepare testing activities before solutions are implemented. We are in the progress of strengthening our processes and “shifting-left” to achieve this target state.

You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle by reviewing acceptance criteria, creating test data, designing and executing tests, supporting business and operators is test decision and execution, and communicating test results and quality concerns. By working closely with both business and development teams, you will help ensure that quality is built into our solutions from the start.

Your key responsibilities are:

  • Work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Participate in requirement reviews, refinement sessions, and solution discussions to identify risks, gaps, and testing needs as early as possible.

  • Help ensure that testing considerations are included early in development activities and that quality is addressed before implementation is completed.

  • Review requirements, user stories, and solution designs to identify potential risks, gaps, and ambiguities.

  • Identify dependencies, prerequisites, and test data requirements for testing activities.

  • Create, maintain, and analyse test data to support testing across different systems and environments.

  • Design, maintain, and execute test cases and test scenarios based on business and technical requirements.

  • Perform manual and exploratory testing to verify functionality, usability, integrations, and business processes.

  • Identify, document, and follow up on defects and quality issues in collaboration with development teams and business stakeholders.

  • Support investigation and root cause analysis of defects and recurring quality issues.

  • Contribute test cases, effort estimates, dependencies, and risks as input to test planning activities.

  • Document and communicate test results, findings, and quality concerns to support project and test management reporting.

  • Collaborate with developers and test automation specialists to improve testing practices and automated quality controls.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methods, test data practices, and quality assurance processes across Nordic RCC.

Proactive position with outstanding attention to detail and excellent communication skills 

On the personal level you have attention to details, good communication and collaboration skills, analytical thinking and problem solving. You are a self-driven and proactive person, responsible, structured and have a strong focus on finding a solution to the problems at hand.

The ideal candidate is expected to have a minimum of 5 years in manual test experience, an education at BA or MA level in computer science or engineering, but experience from a similar role is more important.

Technical skills: 

  • Collaborate with internal and external development teams in the CI/CD process. 

  • Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc), tools, processes, and development cycles (SDLC). 

  • Experience with test data creation

  • Good understanding of test automation

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • ISTQB certification or equivalent 

  • Experience with test management tools - Azure DevOps, Jira, etc. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

Employment conditions 

You will join a team of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 22 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note: The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 1st November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Håkon Rosenaa Nystad, Manager, Quality Management, hny@nordic-rcc.net.

title: Associate Professor in ‘Experimental Nanooptics’.
description:
The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Nano Optics (www.sdu.dk/nano-optics) invites applications for an Associate Professor position in ‘Experimental Nano-Optics’. The starting date is Feb 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The successful candidate is expected to conduct cutting-edge experimental research within nano-optics involving advanced optical characterization of localized and propagating strongly enhanced and confined electromagnetic excitations with the state-of-the-art amplitude and phase-resolved near-field microscope available (NeaSpec). The near-field characterization is expected to be complemented with other optical characterization techniques as well as with performing advanced electromagnetic modelling. The candidate should have documented teaching experience at both BSc and MSc levels along with the corresponding teaching portfolio.

The application material should include a detailed motivation and an outline of the research activities that are to be pursued. In their applications, applicants should highlight their ten most significant journal publications, detailing also their author contributions. Applicants who wish to be considered should provide a link to a fully-updated ResearcherID (www.researcherid.com). The application material should also include detailed accounts on supervision and teaching experience.

The prospective candidates should have a Ph.D. degree in physics, preferably within nano-optics, and documented research experience in the aforementioned experimental techniques. They are expected to have a notable international profile, strong record of research publications, and demonstrated exceptional potential to excel in scientific research. We expect the candidate to actively engage in the development of academic research, conducting vigorous fund raising activities, and educational environment at the Centre for Nano Optics.

The candidate is expected to teach and instruct both graduate and undergraduet students as well as supervise bachelor and master projects. Furthermore, the candicate is expected to contribute actively to young-researcher education through supervision of Ph.D. students and postdoctorial researchers. 

For further information about the position and research infrastructure as well as Centre for Nano Optics, contact Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Read more on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger

Contact information
For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci. 

Further information about this position is available Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Please be aware that we will not accept any email applications, as all applications must be submitted through the SDU online recruitment system.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Research plan for the position in question (max. 2 pages). 
    Upload in the field called "Project description". 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, external funding etc.

  • Verified copies of official Certificates/Diplomas (BSc, MSc and PhD) 

  • List of publications with most relevant publications highlighted.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers, who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: 

Motivated application shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files of max 50 MB per file).

The application deadline is November 1st, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Read more and apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

title: Norwegian or Swedish speaking insurance sales agent (Norwegian market)
description:
Do you like to challenge and are you fluent in Norwegian and/or Swedish and have a profound understanding for the Norwegian market?
- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Norwegian sales department at Nordiccom!

Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. Our Norwegian team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on our sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurance solutions to existing customers in the financial sector. All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone. It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.


Qualities we highly value from you:

- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone

- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people

- A competitive and result-oriented mindset

- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)

- Huge plus if you have experience working with tele sales/telemarketing from a previous job
 

What you can expect from us:

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city.

- Office located in the heart of Copenhagen

 

Who are we and what do we do?
Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

If this sounds interesting to you, please don't hesitate to send your resumé and an application marked "Norwegian sales agent".

title: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

  • Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

  • Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

  • Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

  • Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

  • Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

  • Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

  • A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

  • The best staff meals, enjoyed in our social spaces overlooking the city. 

  • Exciting (on the job) training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO

  • Bring good vibes to the work floor

  • Are genuinely friendly, approachable, and empathetic.

  • Show strong leadership skills and know how to empower and grow their team.

  • Can juggle many tasks at once while remaining cool-headed and warm-hearted.

  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit and never settle for less than amazing.

  • Have worked in an international workplace.

  • Have provable knowledge of maintaining a high standard of guest service and team engagement.


A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You speak fluent Danish and English.

  • You have a minimum of 3 years working experience leading operational teams in the Front Office and/or Food and Beverage department.

  • You’ve worked with PMS and POS software.

  • You are an EU-resident or have a valid Danish working permit.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days/hours.

  • You love to work as we'll need you full time.

title: Postdoc in Behaviour Change interventions (Part-Time, Fixed-Term)
description:
The Danish Centre for Motivation and Behaviour Science (DRIVEN), Research
Unit for Behaviour Science, Motivation and Health (STRIVE) at the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics (IOB), invites applications for a fixed-term, part-time (80%) postdoc position commencing as soon as possible and ending 30 September 2028.

The position is established in connection with the joint project “mPADapp - Digital Decision Support for Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD)” between DRIVEN (SDU), the Institute of Clinical Medicine (IMK) at Aarhus University and the Vascular Research Unit at Viborg Regional Hospital.

About the project

Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) is a major vascular health issue affecting quality of life, mobility, and survival. The mPADapp project aims to improve adherence to clinical guidelines for PAD treatment via an interactive decision support tool. The tool will be integrated into a mobile app for patients and into healthcare providers’ systems, to enhance understanding, motivation, and behaviour change around preventive treatments (e.g. medication adherence, smoking cessation, physical activity etc.). A key component is the development of the app’s behavioural intervention design, grounded in evidence on mechanisms of successful behaviour change.

About the job

The postdoc is expected to manage the design and refinement of an app for telerehabilitation. The role will focus on identifying and integrating effective behaviour change techniques (BCTs), user experience/user-centered design, digital engagement, and mechanisms of motivation, self-regulation, habit formation, and sustained adherence.

Key responsibilities

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary team (clinicians, epidemiologists, app developers, AI-scientists, patient representatives) to co-design the app features that promote sustained behaviour change

  • Review and apply theoretical frameworks and empirical evidence on behaviour change mechanisms (motivation, self-efficacy, intention formation, cues/triggers, habit formation, feedback loops, rewards etc.)

  • Identify BCTs appropriate for PAD patients, particularly those who may have low health literacy, low motivation, sociocultural or economic vulnerabilities

  • Collect and analyse qualitative and quantitative studies (usability testing, field pilots, interviews, survey, digital usage data) to test usability, acceptability, engagement, and mechanisms

  • Contribute to app iteration, interface design, content generation (e.g. messaging, reminders, motivational feedback) ensuring alignment with evidence-based BCTs and self-determination theory

  • Prepare high-quality publications, present at conferences and ensure that findings inform clinical integration and implementation

For information on postdoc positions at the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics in general, please click.

Qualifications

  • A completed PhD or equivalent research experience at PhD level in psychology, behaviour science, public health, digital health, or related field, with demonstrated experience in behaviour change/intervention science

  • Strong knowledge of behaviour change theories and frameworks (e.g. Self-Determination Theory, COM-B, Behaviour Change Wheel, Health Action Process Approach etc.)

  • Experience with digital health interventions or mobile app behaviour support (design and evaluation)

  • Strong collaboration skills, able to work in interdisciplinary teams including clinicians, software developers, and health economists

  • Excellent communication skills in both Danish and English (written and oral)

We offer

  • A stimulating interdisciplinary research environment, with strong ties to vascular surgery, epidemiology, digital health, and user involvement

  • Resources for user panels/patient involvement, usability labs, and collaboration with app developers

  • Opportunities for publication, networking, and professional development

Further information and contact:

For more information about the position and the department, please contact Professor Nikos Ntoumanis, Head of Centre, Tel: (+45) 6550 4525, e-mail: nntoumanis@health.sdu.dk or Jens Troelsen, Head of Department, Tel: (+45) 6550 3493, e-mail: jtroelsen@health.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for the period mentioned above. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years in total at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

The shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Employment as a postdoctoral researcher requires a PhD degree or academic qualifications at PhD level.  

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree or equivalent aacademic qualifications at PhD level (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to 4 of the most relevant publications. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication 

  • Reference letters/references may also be included 

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is 25 October 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics

The Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics adheres to SDU's strategy and values.  Our department is recognized for our interdisciplinary research. The scientific, technical and administrative staff support this through active participation in the department's professional and social life. We prefer candidates with the ambition to make mutual working relationships thrive.

About The Faculty of Health Sciences

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

About Us

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Passenger car auto mechanic
description:
Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled auto mechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,600 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

  • Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems).

  • Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

  • Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors. No work on the high-voltage battery is required.

  • Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

  • Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

  • Are a trained passenger car mechanic

  • Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

  • Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

  • Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

  • Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

  • Hold a category B driving licence

  • Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

  • Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

  • Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

  • To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

  • An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

  • Ongoing training and good development opportunities

  • A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

  • Attractive terms of employment
