Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

title: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

  • Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

  • Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

  • Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

  • Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

  • Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

  • Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

  • Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

  • Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

  • Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

  • Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

  • Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

  • Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

  • UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

  • Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

  • Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

  • Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

  • Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

  • A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

  • Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

  • Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

  • Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

  • Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

  • Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

  • Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

  • EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

  • EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

  • Danish language skills

Your competencies

  • Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

  • Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

  • Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

  • Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

  • Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

  • Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com)

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

As soon as possible / by agreement.

Please send

Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar

title: Mecánico / Service Technician - Relocation - Northen Europe
description:
What to Expect

Join Tesla: Bring Your Skills to Northern Europe

Do you want to help build a world of amazing abundance? At Tesla, that’s our mission.

We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made and as a Service Technician, you’ll help deliver an equally groundbreaking service experience to our customers.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and make a real impact in one of the world’s most sustainable and tech-forward regions? We have open roles across Northen Europe.

Why Move to Northen Europe? 

Relocating to Europe isn’t just a career move, it’s a life upgrade. Here’s what you gain:

  • Top-Tier Quality of Life: Consistently ranked among the happiest and safest countries in the world, clean air, green spaces, and safe cities.

  • Sustainable Living: Live in a country where EVs are the norm, public transport is excellent, and sustainability is woven into daily life.

  • Strong Tech & Innovation Ecosystems: Work at the heart of Europe’s clean energy and tech revolution, with access to cutting-edge tools, R&D and global collaboration.

What You’ll Do

Your Role: Service Technician at Tesla

  • Service, repair and improve: Use Tesla-specific software and advanced diagnostic tools to maintain and repair all Tesla vehicles.

  • Ensure top quality: Fix it right the first time. You’ll inspect vehicles with care before return and pre-delivery, because excellence is non-negotiable.

  • Collaborate ,across teams: Work with local and regional colleagues to share knowledge, solve complex issues, and continuously improve the service experience.

  • Grow with us: Access ongoing training, hands-on workshops, and a blended learning program to develop your technical and leadership skills. Your expertise helps shape the future of Tesla service.

What You’ll Bring

 We’re Looking For:

title: PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING
description:
PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING

Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

About the position

We are looking for a reliable and motivated Production Operator to join our production team. You will work with rolling of metal components and operation of an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine. You do not need to be a qualified welder or have a formal vocational education. The most important things are a good technical understanding, a willingness to learn, attention to quality and the ability to work safely and responsibly.

Your main responsibilities

Ø  Operate rolling machines and production equipment.

Ø  Operate and monitor an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine.

Ø  Set up and make minor adjustments to machines and equipment.

Ø  Monitor the production process and ensure stable production.

Ø  Carry out basic dimensional and visual quality checks.

Ø  Identify deviations and report problems to the team leader or supervisor.

Ø  Keep your workplace clean, organized and safe.

Ø  Follow company procedures for quality, safety and production.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be formally trained as a welder or have a vocational qualification. We are looking for someone who:

Ø  Has experience from manufacturing, metalworking, machine operation or a similar production environment – experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ø  Has a good technical understanding and enjoys working with machines.

Ø  Is practical, reliable and willing to learn.

Ø  Can work independently but also contributes positively to the team.

Ø  Has a strong focus on quality and safety.

Ø  Is comfortable with repetitive production tasks and physical work.

Ø  Can understand basic instructions, measurements and simple technical information.

Ø  Is able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Training and introduction

Full training will be provided. You will receive a structured introduction to the machines, production processes, quality requirements and safety procedures. Previous experience with automatic welding or rolling is therefore not essential.

What we offer

A stable position in a modern production environment.

Thorough training and support from experienced colleagues.

A practical and varied working day.

A workplace where safety, quality and teamwork are important.

Good opportunities to develop your technical skills and take on more responsibility over time.

Competitive salary and employment conditions according to qualifications and experience.

Working environment

You will become part of a team where we value cooperation, respect and a good working atmosphere. We believe that good production results are created by people who work together, help each other and take responsibility for their work.

Working hours

The position is day shift and 37 hours / week

Location

Tcomp | Tjæreborg Kompensatorfabrik A/S,  Kærvej 19, 6731 Tjæreborg, Denmark

 

How to apply

Applications should be sent to: ng.sandberg@tcomp.dk

About us

Tcomp is a Danish manufacturing company based in Tjæreborg, near Esbjerg. We specialize in metal production and manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and reliable solutions for our customers.

We are a hands-on company where teamwork, safety and respect for each other are important parts of everyday life. We believe that good results are created by skilled and committed people working together.

title: SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN? - ARE YOU READY TO JOIN THE JOURNEY?
description:
SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN?

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent med ambitioner

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som både er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig.

Måske har du mange års erfaring med rengøring. Måske har du arbejdet i private hjem, hos erhvervskunder, med kvalitetssikring eller koordinering. Eller måske ved du bare, at du kan mere, end du får mulighed for at vise i dit nuværende job.

Så kan RenTid være stedet for dig.

⚠️ EN VIGTIG TING, DU SKAL VIDE

Hos RenTid starter alle på gulvet.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent – ikke som leder, supervisor eller direktør.

Du starter sammen med alle andre, ude hos kunderne og med rengøringen i hænderne.

Vi er ikke så optagede af din titel eller hvad der står på dit CV. Vi vil se:

  • Hvad du kan

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Din indstilling og arbejdsmoral

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder og kollegaer

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har det, der skal til for at vokse med RenTid

HVOR KAN DET FØRE DIG HEN?

Det ved vi ikke på forhånd. Det afhænger af dig.

Når RenTid vokser, opstår nye muligheder. Den rigtige medarbejder kan derfor med tiden få mere ansvar, eksempelvis:

  • Ansvar for bestemte kunder

  • Kvalitetskontrol

  • Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

  • Koordinering af kollegaer

  • Planlægning af opgaver

  • Kundekontakt

  • Ansvar for bestemte områder

  • Teamlederfunktioner

  • Driftsansvar

  • På længere sigt endnu større ansvar i virksomheden

Mulighederne er mange, hvis du viser, at du er klar til dem.

Vi vil gerne finde en person, som på sigt kan blive en central del af RenTid. Men større ansvar, højere løn og flere goder følger med det, du viser, du kan løfte.

DU STARTER MED EN GOD LØN

Vi tilbyder en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Men vi er også ærlige: Du starter ikke på en direktørløn.

Som rengøringsassistent får du ikke automatisk lederansvar, højere løntrin, fri firmabil, fri telefon eller andre goder, der følger med større ansvar.

Det arbejder man sig frem til.

Når du tager ansvar, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte en større rolle, følger mulighederne med.

DINE OPGAVER

Du skal først og fremmest kunne det vigtigste:

Rengøring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn, både private hjem og erhvervskunder.

Du skal kunne arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt og forstå, at vores kunder forventer et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Hos RenTid skal rengøring ikke bare overstås.

Det skal gøres ordentligt.

Du skal have øje for detaljerne, tage ansvar og sætte en ære i at levere et resultat, der lever op til RenTids standarder.

HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG?

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Men vi forventer, at du vil blive bedre.

Du skal:

  • Være mødestabil og fleksibel

  • Have en positiv attitude

  • Have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Kunne arbejde selvstændigt og i team

  • Have øje for detaljer

  • Sætte en ære i et perfekt resultat

  • Tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kunne modtage og bruge feedback konstruktivt

  • Være loyal over for kunder, kollegaer og RenTid

  • Være løsningsorienteret

  • Kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

  • Have kørekort kategori B

  • Selv kunne komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus

  • Være indforstået med, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde

  • Tale, forstå, læse, og skrive Engelsk

Har du ikke kørekort B, eller ønsker du ikke at køre bil, er stillingen ikke den rette for dig.

⭐ ERFARING ER VIGTIGT

Vi søger en person med stor erfaring inden for rengøring i private hjem. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er det ikke dig, vi søger.

Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring er en klar fordel.

Du skal kende de grundlæggende principper inden for professionel rengøring og kunne arbejde effektivt uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Hos RenTid skærer vi ikke hjørnerne. Vi gør tingene ordentligt.

Men erfaring alene er ikke nok.

Vi leder også efter:

Mindset. Arbejdsmoral. Ansvar. Vilje. Drive.

Du skal have lyst til at blive bedre – og lyst til at blive mere.

⏱️ DE FØRSTE 3 MÅNEDER

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode i henhold til gældende danske regler.

Det er en periode, hvor både du og vi finder ud af, om vi er det rigtige match.

Vi ser blandt andet på:

  • Hvordan du møder på arbejde

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder

  • Hvordan du fungerer med kollegaer

  • Hvordan du reagerer på feedback

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har lyst til at lære

  • Om du har det drive, vi leder efter

Hvis svaret er ja, kan de første tre måneder blive begyndelsen på noget langt større.

HOS RеNTID KAN DU UDVIKLE DIG

Vi tror på, at mennesker kan udvikle sig.

Derfor vil vi hellere finde den rigtige person med det rigtige mindset end den flotteste titel på CV'et.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan blive leder.

Vis os det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan tage ansvar.

Tag det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du har ambitioner.

Vis dem.

HVIS DU VIL MERE...

Vi kan ikke love dig en lederstilling om seks måneder, en firmabil om et år eller en direktørløn.

Det skal du gøre dig fortjent til.

Men vi kan love dig dette:

Hvis du arbejder hårdt, tager ansvar, udvikler dig, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte mere, så vil vi gerne give dig mulighederne for at vokse.

For når RenTid vokser, skal vores medarbejdere have mulighed for at vokse med.

Her starter alle på gulvet. Hvor langt du kan komme derfra, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Stillingen er primært i Aarhus og omegn.

Du skal kunne transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen og være indstillet på, at arbejdsdagen kan foregå hos forskellige kunder.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en ansøgning og dit CV med billede, hvor du fortæller:

  • Hvem du er

  • Hvor længe du har arbejdet med rengøring

  • Din erfaring med private hjem

  • Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

  • Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

  • Hvorfor du passer godt ind hos RenTid

Skriv gerne din ansøgning på Engelsk Mærk ansøgningen "The Journey".

"Jeg skal med på rejsen"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

JOIN US ON THE JOURNEY!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaner with ambition

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaner who is highly skilled at their profession and wants to develop further.

Perhaps you have many years of experience in cleaning, private homes, commercial cleaning, quality control or coordination. Or perhaps you simply know that you have more to offer than you currently get the opportunity to show.

Then RenTid might be the right place for you.

⚠️ ONE IMPORTANT THING YOU NEED TO KNOW

At RenTid, everyone starts on the floor.

You will be hired as a cleaner – not as a manager, supervisor or director.

You start alongside everyone else, working directly with our customers and the cleaning itself.

We are less interested in titles and more interested in seeing:

  • What you can do

  • How you work

  • Your attitude and work ethic

  • How you treat customers and colleagues

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you have what it takes to grow with RenTid

WHERE CAN THIS JOURNEY TAKE YOU?

We don't know in advance.

That depends on you.

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right person can gradually take on more responsibility, such as:

  • Responsibility for specific customers

  • Quality control

  • Training new employees

  • Coordinating colleagues

  • Planning tasks

  • Customer communication

  • Responsibility for specific areas

  • Team leader responsibilities

  • Operational responsibility

  • Greater responsibility within the company over time

There are many opportunities if you show that you are ready for them.

Greater responsibility, higher salary and additional benefits come with what you demonstrate that you can handle.

YOU START WITH A GOOD SALARY

We offer a good and fair salary from day one.

But we are also honest: You will not start on a director's salary.

Management responsibility, higher salary levels, private use of a company car, company phone and other benefits are not automatic.

They are things you work your way towards.

As you take responsibility and deliver results, the opportunities will follow.

YOUR INITIAL ROLE

First and foremost, you need to be able to do the most important thing:

Clean.

You will work at customer locations in Aarhus and the surrounding areas, including private homes and commercial clients.

You must be able to work professionally and independently and understand that our customers expect a result they can be proud of.

At RenTid, cleaning is not something to rush through.

It has to be done properly.

You should have an eye for detail, take responsibility and take pride in meeting RenTid's standards.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

We don't expect you to be perfect. But we expect you to want to become better.

You must:

  • Be reliable and flexible

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Be willing to learn and develop

  • Work independently and as part of a team

  • Have an eye for detail

  • Take pride in delivering a perfect result

  • Take responsibility for your work

  • Receive and use feedback constructively

  • Be loyal to customers, colleagues and RenTid

  • Be solution-oriented

  • Maintain an overview in a busy environment

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Be able to get to and from work in Aarhus independently

  • Be comfortable with possible weekend work

  • Speak, understand, read, and write English

If you do not have a Category B licence or do not want to drive, this position is not for you.

⭐ EXPERIENCE MATTERS

We are looking for someone with extensive experience cleaning private homes. If you do not have this experience, this position is not for you.

Experience with commercial cleaning is a clear advantage.

You should already understand professional cleaning principles and be able to work efficiently without compromising quality.

At RenTid, we don't cut corners. We do things properly.

Experience alone is not enough.

We are also looking for:

Mindset. Work ethic. Responsibility. Determination. Drive.

You must want to become better – and want to become more.

⏱️ THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

The first 3 months are a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish employment law.

This is a period where both you and RenTid can determine whether we are the right match.

We will look at:

  • How you show up for work

  • How you work

  • How you treat customers

  • How you work with colleagues

  • How you respond to feedback

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you want to learn

  • Whether you have the drive we are looking for

If the answer is yes, these first three months could be the beginning of something much bigger.

AT RENTID, YOU CAN DEVELOP

We believe people can develop.

That is why we would rather find the right person with the right mindset than the person with the most impressive title on their CV.

You don't need to tell us you can become a manager.

Show us.

You don't need to tell us you can take responsibility.

Take it.

You don't need to tell us you have ambition.

Show us.

IF YOU WANT MORE...

We cannot promise you a management position in six months, a company car in a year or a director's salary.

You have to earn it.

But we can promise you this:

If you work hard, take responsibility, develop yourself, deliver results and show that you can handle more, we want to give you opportunities to grow.

Because when RenTid grows, our employees should have the opportunity to grow with it.

Everyone starts on the floor. How far you go from there will largely depend on you.

WORKING AREA

The position is primarily based in Aarhus and the surrounding areas.

You must be able to travel to and from work and be comfortable working at different customer locations.

RenTid provides a car for you or your team during working hours.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV with a photo, including:

  • Who you are

  • How long you have worked in cleaning

  • Your experience with private homes

  • Any commercial cleaning experience

  • What you would like to develop within

  • Why you believe you would be a good fit for RenTid

Please write your application in English . Please mark your application: “The Journey”.

"I want to join the journey"

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

title: PhD Position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education
description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This is a unique position in that research and its consequences sit in the same place. You will not be studying a distant phenomenon and writing it up; you will be running studies in live courses, designing interventions from what you find, and seeing them change how software engineering is taught. If you see yourself as someone who wants to help our discipline navigate the AI disruption rather than wait for it to settle, this is that opportunity.

 

Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and conduct empirical studies of how software engineering students generally use generative AI — how they justify it, what they delegate to it, and where their agency is preserved or surrendered.

  • Translate those findings into agency artifacts, practicum activities, and assessment designs that can be used by real instructors in real courses.

  • Co-develop and evaluate self-learning components, and contribute to alignment work on intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment together with the ITU stream.

  • Work directly with the head of programs and instructors to implement classroom interventions, whose buy-in is what makes this kind of change hold. Persuading colleagues is part of the craft here, not an afterthought.

  • Publish in leading venues for computing education research, and present internationally.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a closely related field, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree and including a substantial thesis component. The degree must be completed before the starting date. Students with master’s in education and related fields are welcome to apply.

  • A grade average at or above 10 on the Danish 7-point scale, or a documented equivalent from the awarding institution. Applicants with degrees from outside Denmark should include a grading scale and, where available, a conversion statement.

  • Documented ability to carry out independent scientific work, evidenced by the master’s thesis.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • A software engineering background, with practical familiarity with how software is actually built — you should be able to judge whether an AI-assisted solution is sound, not only whether it runs.

  • A genuine motivation for teaching and education, both in delivery and as an object of research.

  • The ability to design and carry out empirical studies involving students, and to engage stakeholders for support.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Prior research and publication experience.

  • Experience with empirical research methods — interventions, experiment, interviews, coding, thematic or pattern analysis — and with mixed-methods designs.

  • Familiarity with computing education research, or with constructive alignment as a course design framework.

  • Teaching or teaching-assistant experience at university level.

  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in software development, and a considered view of where they help and where they do not.

 

Personal competences

  • Critical and ingenious thinking. You question assumptions — including your own, including ours, and including the ones embedded in our education design and the AI tools you will be studying. You are as interested in what a finding does not show as in what it does.

  • A demonstrated passion for software engineering and its education. This project asks you to care about how the next generation of engineers is formed, not only about publishing on the topic.

  • The ability to bring colleagues along. Much of this work happens through instructors and program leaderships who own their courses. We value someone who can earn agreement through evidence, patience, and good listening rather than argument alone.

  • Independence paired with collaboration. You will drive your own studies, and you will do it inside a two-university project with shared deliverables and deadlines.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be researching people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

  • Comfort with iteration. Design-based research means your first intervention will be wrong in interesting ways. That is the method working, not failing.

 

Workplace description

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Two recommendation letters, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

  • Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million
  • Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics
  • Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
  • Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements
  • Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
  • Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
  • Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance
  • Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

  • Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option
  • Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
  • The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently
  • The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers
  • The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
  • The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications
  • A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

  • A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development
  • A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
  • Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
  • Good opportunities for both professional and personal development
  • Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance
  • A good canteen scheme and active staff association
  • An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s

title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals
description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Associate Professor, and Curator of Mammals at Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark wishes to appoint a Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals (mammalia) with a great vision for natural history museums in a changing world. Duties are divided equally between collection-based research and other museum duties including curation of the mammal collections, research-based teaching and supervision of students, public engagement work, and to act as the museum's liaison with relevant Danish natural history communities. The successful applicant will be expected to establish and develop an externally funded collection-based research programme/group and publish in influential journals. We particularly encourage applications from applicants with a collection-based research specialization on mammalogy. The successful applicant will be expected to curate the museum’s historically important mammal collections (56.000 specimens) requiring a thorough understanding and practical knowledge of mammal classification. We value collaboration across disciplines and professions. All applicants are expected to demonstrate interdisciplinary thinking and a commitment to working together to create solutions to global challenges. This also goes for collection work. Curators develop the collections that they are responsible for through research, field work, loan activities, digitization, acting as scientific host for visiting researchers, and increasing accessibility for everyone. This curatorial position in Mammalogy at the Natural History Museum Denmark will be filled at either the Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level. All curators at the Natural History Museum Denmark are expected to take a leading role in society as advocates for science and nature, creating impact at all levels while actively promoting the museum’s Vision and Values (https://snm.dk/en/about-museum). Further details of qualifications required for appointment at the museum are detailed below.

The position is available starting March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Qualifications
Tenure-track assistant professor
Applicants at the tenure track assistant professor level are expected to have an academic record demonstrating the potential to deliver high profile internationally competitive research in the area of specialization. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have experience with collection-based research. Previous experience curating natural history collections and university teaching experience would be advantageous but is not a requirement at the time of hiring for tenure-track assistant professors. Documented interest in and experience with public engagement and community-based activities is expected. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar institution is an advantage.

Associate professor
Applicants at the associate professor level are expected to have a strong publication record in high-level, international, peer-reviewed venues in the area of specialization and a track record of successful external research funding. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have significant experience with collection-based research. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar is expected. Curatorial expertise and considerable previous experience and impact with curating and developing natural history collections is required at associate professor level. Broad experience and a compelling vision for public engagement and community-based activities is essential. Candidates are also required to have documented university-level competencies in delivering high-quality undergraduate/graduate teaching and must be able to explain and reflect upon their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

Assessment of applicants
Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research as well as their curatorial experience and potential to curate one or more of the museum’s collections. Teaching and public engagement qualifications and experience will be considered according to career level. The overall fit for the Natural History Museum will also be considered.
Ideal applicants will have the following qualifications:

  • An outstanding reputation for high-quality research within Mammalogy
  • A record of scientific use of museum collections and/or data
  • A proven track record of interdisciplinary research
  • Scientific expertise that ensures ability to curate Mammalia collections held by the museum
  • Curatorial experience improving and developing natural history collections
  • Experience from a natural history museum or similar
  • Participation in national and international museum collaborations through organizations and programs.
  • A vision for how digital, genomic, and other new technologies will drive advances in natural history science
  • Ability to work at a strategic level
  • A track record of public engagement and creating impact beyond academia
  • Experience working on museum exhibitions, interpretation, and/or public engagement
  • Experience in fundraising and ability to attract research funding from external sources for research, digitization and collection development.
  • Supportive and collaborative people skills and commitment to an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and respect for everyone with equality and opportunity for all
  • A passion for the vision and values of the Natural History Museum Denmark
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Confidence in ability to provide advocacy for the museum with multiple stakeholders
University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor/associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.
For tenure-track assistant professors
For associate professors

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

Information on the tenure-track programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period, tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

About the Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark is the Danish national museum for nature. We work to empower citizens to connect with nature with the aim to create positive change for people and planet. We want to inspire, engage, and enable people to enjoy, understand, and care for the diversity of the natural world. The impact of climate change and anthropogenic forces on biodiversity has reached a critical point. We firmly believe that natural history museums can and should play a key role towards a more sustainable relationship with nature. We are opening a new Danish national museum for nature in spring 2027. One big museum site, in the Botanical Garden, in the centre of Copenhagen, will host state-of-the-art laboratories, outstanding research collections, new public galleries, and combined facilities for programming, education, and citizen science. It is an ambition for the museum to enhance natural history and inspire curiosity, knowledge, and empowerment for the future. The Botanical Garden was founded in 1600, and the museum’s collections date back to Ole Worm’s Cabinet of Curiosities from around 1620. With 14 million preserved specimens and living plants of 8,000 different species in the Botanical Garden, it is the largest museum collection in Denmark. It covers our planetary history with botanical, zoological, and geological specimens from all over the world. Read more about the Mammalia collection here.

The Natural History Museum Denmark is part of the University of Copenhagen, which was founded in 1479 and is the largest university in Denmark. Read more about the museum here.
Inquiries about the position can be made to Museum Director Nina Rønsted (e-mail: nronsted@snm.ku.dk).

Affirmative action
The Natural History Museum Denmark is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disabled status. We are actively promoting a strategy to improve the gender balance among scientific staff. Copenhagen is a highly diverse and international Scandinavian capital with a green profile. Education is free and childcare is subsidized. Public transport is well developed, and most Copenhageners take their bike to work. There are lots of green areas in and around Copenhagen, the water in the harbor is clean enough for swimming, and the city has multiple museums and other cultural venues.

Terms of employment
Employment is as tenure-track assistant professor/associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The successful applicant is expected to take Danish lessons if there is no prior knowledge of Danish language. The International Office at the University of Copenhagen can help.
This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPHs extensive support for international researchers here

How to apply
The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae documenting:
    • Previous positions at museums, universities, or other research or cultural institutions
    • Fundraising experience
    • International network and relations
    • Curatorial experience (curation of collections)
    • Public engagement activities, i.e. citizen science projects, exhibitions, popular lectures or other relevant activities
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc- and MSc-students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Diplomas (MSc and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, impact, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is November 2 2026 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. We work thoroughly with this process. Several professionals from different fields must be involved. Therefore, we will not be ready for interviews until February 2027.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

title: Material Coordinator
description:
Brænder du for koordinering, logistik og materialestyring? Er du struktureret, serviceminded og trives med mange kontaktflader i en dynamisk hverdag? Så er du måske vores nye Material Coordinator.

Rolle og ansvarsområder

Som Material Coordinator bliver du en vigtig del af OMC-teamet, hvor du får en central rolle i at sikre effektiv håndtering af materialer, udstyr og logistiske processer mellem offshore-installationer, varehus, indkøb, leverandører og interne interessenter.

Stillingen er på 30 timer.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Håndtering og koordinering af backload-processer mellem offshore og onshore lokationer.

  • Opfølgning på leveringstider og dialog med indkøb om fremrykning af materialer.

  • Koordinering med bådtransport og varehus ved modtagelse og afsendelse af materialer.

  • Sikre hurtig returnering af lejeudstyr til leverandører.

  • Oprettelse og koordinering af serviceordrer til reparation af udstyr, herunder:

  • Assistere med lukning af Repair-ordrer for at sikre korrekt håndtering af økonomiske commitments.

  • Rådgivning og support ved spørgsmål omkring materialerouting til offshore-destinationer.

  • Sparringspartner for Unisol-teamet i forbindelse med forbedringer, fejl og optimering af SAP-processer.

  • Oprettelse af manuelle Purchase Requisitions til materialeindkøb.

  • Opfølgning på kvalitetskontrol (QC) for frigivelse af materialer i samarbejde med indkøb og leverandører.

  • Gennemføre materialegennemgang på kampagnebåde samt koordinere pick/pack-aktiviteter med planlæggere, varehus og bådpersonale.

  • Opfølgning på hasteordrer og kritiske materialebehov fra offshore.

  • Koordinering af reparationer på udstyr modtaget fra offshoreinstallationer.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af transporter via vejtransport.

 

Hvem er du?

  • Har erfaring inden for logistik, supply chain, materialestyring eller lagerfunktioner

  • Har erfaring med SAP eller tilsvarende ERP-systemer

  • Er struktureret og god til at holde overblik over mange opgaver samtidigt

  • Trives med koordinering på tværs af flere afdelinger og interessenter

  • Er løsningsorienteret og har en proaktiv tilgang til opgaver

  • Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og god kundeservice

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag i et dynamisk miljø.

  • Tæt samarbejde med offshore, indkøb, lager, logistik og teknikere.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og stor indflydelse på arbejdsprocesser.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på samarbejde, videndeling og kontinuerlige forbedringer.

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Deltidsstilling 30 timer, med 1 ugentlig fridag i rul med resten af teamet.

Om NorSea

House of Offshore Innovation er et kontorfællesskab med både nationale og internationale virksomheder fra energiindustrien. Vi udlejer kontor- og mødelokaler og deler husets ressourcer og viden med hinanden.

NorSea Denmark er en del af NorSea Group, og er ejet af Wilhelmsen. Vi opererer Danmarks største offshore supply base. Gennem vores one-stop-shop koncept servicerer vi energisektoren med totale supply chain løsninger.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, der hele tiden forsøger at udvikle os gennem innovation. Vores vigtigste aktiv er vores medarbejdere, og vi har det som vores mission at være Best Place to Work. Vi bor i vores nyrenoverede domicil, House of Offshore Innovation i Esbjerg. Hér tilbyder vi vores medarbejdere attraktive vilkår, herunder; personalerestaurant, fitnesslokale, aktiv personaleforening m.m.

NorSea Denmark is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to the maritime and offshore industry. The group operates 12 supply bases in the North Sea, and our base in Esbjerg is Denmark’s largest. We are part of the NorSea Group - a global provider of base operations and full service logistics solutions with 50 years of experience.

NorSea Group is owned by one of the world’s largest maritime industrial group, Wilhelmsen. As an experienced and reliable one-stop-shop, we at NorSea Denmark aim to set new industry standards for efficiency and safety. We deliver all types of logistics and base solutions to the offshore sector. With a deep understanding of our customers’ commercial interests and needs, we innovate safe and profitable solutions.

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at blive en vigtig del af forsyningskæden og sikre, at de rette materialer er tilgængelige på rette tid og sted? Så ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Michael Zdrinka Clausen, Warehouse Manager på michael.clausen@norseagroup.com eller +45 21946317

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. oktober eller når den rette kandidat er fundet.

description:

Om stillingen:

Vi søger en engageret medarbejder til vores specialiserede butik med fokus på japanske kvalitetsknive og japansk knivhåndværk.

Stillingen er en kombination af salg og kundeservice, arbejde med slibning af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen kombinerer salg og kundeservice med praktisk arbejde, slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

En væsentlig del af stillingen indebærer direkte kommunikation med japanske producenter og leverandører. Derfor er gode japanske sprogkundskaber en nødvendighed kompetence i stillingen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Salg og rådgivning af kunder om japanske kvalitetsknive og tilbehør.

Kundeservice og vejledning om valg, brug og vedligeholdelse af knive.

Slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive, samt indgravering i hånden.

Modtagelse, kontrol og håndtering af varer.

Vare- og lagerstyring.

Kommunikation med japanske leverandører og producenter,

Håndtering af profuktinformation, ordrer, specifikationer og leverancer.

Oversættelse og videreformidling af information mellem virksomheden og japanske leverandører.

Bidrage til den daglige drift og præsentation af butikken.

Vi forventer, at du:

Taler og skriver japansk på højt niveau.

Kan kommunikere proffesionelt med vores japanske leverandører både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Har interesse for japanske knive, håndværk og kvalitet.

Har gode kundeservice- og salgsevner.

Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst.

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

Har interesse for eller erfaring med knivslibning.

Behersker engelsk, så du kan kommunikere med kolleger og kunder.

Erfaring med knivslibning, salg eller arbejde med japanske knive er en fordel. Erfaring med håndgravering er ligeledes en fordel. Oplæring i virksomhedens produkter og arbejdsmetoder vil blive givet efter behov.

Japansk er et nødvendigt arbejdssprog, da medarbejderne vil have løbende kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører, vedrørende blandt andet produktinformation, bestillinger, specifikationer og leverancer.

Vi tilbyder:

Fast ansættelse på 37 timer om ugen.

En alsidig stilling i en specialiseret butik.

Arbejde med japanske kvalitetsprodukter og knivhåndværk.

Direkte kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører.

Oplæring i produkter, knivtyper og slibeteknikker.

Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og god kundeservice.

Løn: Efter aftale.

Ansøgning:

Send CV og ansøgning til tess@foodgear.dk.

Fortæl gerne om din baggrund og erfaring med japansk håndværk, samt dine sprogkundskaber.

Regarding the position:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and service-minded employee to join our specialized shop, focusing on high quality Japanese knives and Japanese knife craftmanship.

The position combines sales and customer service with practical work, involving knife sharpening and maintenance, as well as ongoing communication with our Japanese suppliers and business partners.

A significant part of the postion involves direct communication with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers. Therefore, a high level of Japanese language proficiency is an essential requirement for the position.

Your responsibilities:

Selling and advising customers on Japanese high quality knives and accessories.

Providing customer service andguidance on the selection, use and maintenance of knives.

Knife sharpening, maintenance and hand engraving.

Receiving, checking and handling goods.

Stock and inventory management.

Communication with Japanese suppliers and manufacturers.

Handling product information, orders, specifications and deliveries.

Translating and communicating information between the company and Japanese business partners.

Contributing to the day-to-day operation and presentation of the shop.

We expect you to:

Speak and write Japanese at a high level.

Be able to communicate professionally with Japanese suppliers, both verbally and in writing.

Have an interest in Japanese knives, craftmanship and quality.

Have good customer service and sales skills.

Be detail oriented and quality conscious.

Be able to work independently and take responsibility.

Have an interest in or experience with knife sharpening.

Have a good command of English for communication with colleagues and customers.

Experience in sales, knife sharpening or working with Japaneseknives is an advantage. Experience with hand engraving of knives is also an advantage. Training in the companys products and working methods will be provided as required.

Japanese is an essential working language, as the employee will have regular contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers regarding product information, orders, specifikations, deliveries and other matters related to our Japanese products.

We offer:

A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

A varied position in a specialised retail shop.

The opportunity to work with high-quality Japanese products and traditional knife craftmanship.

Direct contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers.

Training in products, knife types and sharpening techniques.

A working environment focused on quality, expertise and excellent customer service.

Salary: Salary and employment terms according to qualifications and experience.

How to apply: Please send an email with your CV and application to tess@foodgear.dk

Please include information about your experience with Japanese products, knives, sales, customer service as well as your Japanese and English skills.

MIG/MAG keevitus -> rasketehnika /hüdrosilindrid

Tööülesanded: Sinu igapäevased kangelasteod:

Rasketehnika masti ja detailide keevitus: mõrad- faasimine/keevitus. Ja palju muud... Meeskonna toetamine defekteerimisel ja masinate lahtivõtmisel. Töö on mitmekülgne ja eriprojekte on palju. Võimalus õppida juurde lihtsamat treitööd! Sellel teekonnal on toeks kogu meeskond, sest tihti hõlmab masina või hüdrosilindri remont mitut etappi: -Lahtivõtt ja defekteerimine -Pakkumise tegemine/eeldatavad töötunnid projektile -Tööde planeerimine -Võimalikud treitööd -Materjalide tellimine -Keevitus/kooste -Avade taastamine -Sirgestus -Uute detailide valmistamine /tellimine -Joonestamine -Hooldus -Montaaž See on ülevaade kogu meeskonna tööst! Kui oled meeskonnamängija, siis see üldsegi mitte igav ja mitmekülgne töö võib olla just Sulle! Me ei eelda, et Sa oskad kõike. Kui Sul on suur huvi rasketehnika ja metallitööde vastu, siis see on juba kõige olulisem. Kuulutuses märgitud palk ei ole ülempiir- see on meie miinimum. Initsiatiiv+motivatsioon+tööde teostamise kiirus= kõrgem palk! Kui soovid täpsemat tööde kirjeldust, siis helista või tule kohale meiega tutvuma!

Muud nõuded: Mida me Sinult ootame
Põhioskused: MIG/MAG keevitus. Oled eelisjärjekorras kui: Sul on varasem reaalne kokkupuude rasketehnika hooldusega, teadmised hüdraulikast, hüdrosilindritest ning tunned metalli ja selle töötlemist. Kuldne tase: kui oskad vahetada hüdrosilindril tihendid täiesti iseseisvalt ja seda ka testida/stendida (220bar). Oled meil kohe nimekirja tipus! Lisapunktid: TIG keevitus ja elektrood ning oskus teha lihtsamaid treitöid manuaalsel treipingil annavad sulle tugeva eelise. Võidab siiski kirg rasketehnika vastu ja soov/tahe töötada metalliga!
