title: Keikkalaiseksi Teeritien palvelukotiin Lieksaan (lähihoitaja, sosionomi, sairaanhoitaja)
description:
Etsitkö joustavaa ja elämääsi sopivaa tapaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Me Honkalampi-säätiössä haemme nyt keikkalaisia **ohjaajan tehtäviin**Polvijärvelle, Kurjenpolven palvelukotiin. Taustaltasi voit olla esimerkiksi lääkeluvallinen **lähihoitaja, sosionomi tai sairaanhoitaja.**

Teeritien palvelukoti tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista 18 aikuiselle tukea tarvitsevalle henkilölle, joiden tuen tarpeen taustalla on esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä jokaisen arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja oikeudesta elää oman näköistä elämää. Huolehdimme turvallisesta ympäristöstä, jossa vuorovaikutus ja monipuoliset kommunikaation keinot ovat keskiössä. Haluamme, että kotimme on paikka, jossa jokainen tulee kuulluksi, ymmärretyksi ja kohdatuksi omana itsenään. Meillä koti on koti.

**Millaista työ on?**

Ohjaajana tuet ja mahdollistat asukkaidemme arkea heidän omien toiveidensa, tarpeidensa ja tavoitteidensa mukaisesti. Työhösi kuuluu hoitotyötä ja hyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä asukkaiden avustamista arjen askareissa, kuten kodinhoidossa, kaupassa käynnissä ja ulkoilussa.

Lisäksi suunnittelet ja toteutat yhdessä asukkaiden kanssa heidän toiveistaan lähtevää yhteistä toimintaa, joka voi olla esimerkiksi liikkumista, leivontaa, pelaamista, retkiä, digitaitojen harjoittelua tai ihan vain yhdessä olemista ja jutustelua.

Keikkalaisena toimit ohjaajan sijaisuuksissa tarpeen mukaan. Keikat voivat olla äkillisiä ja lyhyitä poissaolojen tuurauksia, mutta tarjoamme myös pidempiä sijaisuuksia ensisijaisesti keikkalaisillemme. Voit itse päättää, mitkä keikkapyynnöt hyväksyt.

**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme kehitysvamma-alasta kiinnostuneita, ihmisläheisiä ja vastuullisia keikkalaisia. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja työyhteisötaitoja sekä valmiutta ottaa vastaan sijaisuuksia myös lyhyellä varoitusajalla. Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa sote-alan koulutusta (esim. lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, sosionomi) tai vähintään 2/3 alan opinnoista suoritettuna

- lääkehoidon koulutusta ja voimassa olevia lääketenttien suorituksia

- voimassa olevaa sote-ammattikorttia

- tartuntatautilain 48 § mukaista rokotesuojaa

- hygieniapassia ja elintarviketyötä tekevän terveydentilaselvitystä.


Valitun työntekijän tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkua.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- joustavan, elämääsi sopivan tavan tehdä töitä keikkalaisena

- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisen tuntipalkan (kelpoisuusehdot täyttävän ohjaajan palkkaluokka G20C)

- huolellisen perehdytyksen keikkalaisen tehtäviin

- kokeneen ja helposti lähestyttävän esihenkilön ja työyhteisön tuen.


Pääset osaksi ainutlaatuisten asukkaidemme arkea, saat arvokasta kokemusta kehitysvamma-alalta ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoiset työkaverit - meillä et jää yksin.

**Näin haet meille töihin**

Täytä hakemuslomake nettisivuillamme:https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/

Lisätietoja tehtävistä voit kysyä osoitteesta rekrytointi@hl-s.fi .

Voit tutustua asumispalveluiden arkeen Facebookissa: @Honkalampi Asumispalvelut tai Instagramissa: @honkalampiasumispalvelut .

_Honkalampi on yhteiskuntavastuullinen yritys, jonka tavoitteena on pykälää parempi maailma. Käytämme taloudelliset voittovaramme asiakkaidemme palveluiden kehittämiseen ja yhteiskunnallisten haasteiden ratkaisemiseen. Tutustu meihin lisää osoitteessa www.honkalampi.fi ._

_Honkalammen asumispalvelut on savuton työpaikka._

title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, Permanent Position ,
description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a permanent position in the natural paradise of Föglö, Åland Islands (a temporary position is possible if desired).

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: full-time: 37.5h/week
- Salary: approx. 13-14.50 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen (halutessasi määräaikaisuus on mahdollinen).

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: täydet tunnit: 37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 13-14,50eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan
- Työehtosopimus: Elintarvikealan TES
- Työsuhde: Boltin kautta
- Aloitus joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan
- Roolissa on hyvä mahdollisuus edetä

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: majoitut tyypillisesti toisen työntekijän kanssa rivitalokaksiossa tai -kolmiossa, ja vuokra on n. 300-450eur, ja sisältää, tai ei sisällä sähköä / vettä, riippuen asunnosta (saat tarkan tiedon työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Tietoa Kalaneuvoksesta:
Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Haethan työpaikkaa pian: paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: CNC TURNER - MAZAK PROGRAMMER

title: Lähihoitaja/sairaanhoitaja
description:

Työ sijoittuu pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin klo 8.00–18.00 väliselle ajalle. Työvuoroja voi tarvittaessa olla myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja
description:
**Henkilökohtainen avustaja Tampere ja lähikunnat**

Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle **henkilökohtaisen avun**pariin? Olemme hyväksytty palvelusetelituottaja Tampereen alueella henkilökohtaisen avun piirissä. Tehtävään ei ole koulutusvaatimuksia, hyvällä asenteella pärjää pitkälle.

**Spesio – Omanlainen elämä**

Tarkoituksenasi on tukea asiakasta niin, että hän pystyy elämään mahdollisimman itsenäistä arkea ja omanlaista elämää. Tehtävänäsi on avustaa asiakasta sellaisissa tavanomaisissa päivittäistoiminnoissa, joista asiakas ilman vamman tai sairauden tuomaa rajoitetta suoriutuisi itsenäisesti. Näihin saattaa sisältyä muun muassa avustamista pukeutumisessa, henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa, vaate- ja ruokahuollossa, kodinhoidossa tai kodin ulkopuolisissa toiminnoissa, kuten kaupassa käynnissä, ulkoilussa ja harrastuksissa. Käynnit saattavat sisältää asiakkaan siirtoja ja nostoja eli edellytämme hyvää fyysistä peruskuntoa.

Asiakaskäynnin tarkemman sisällön sekä keston määrittelee asiakkaan tarve. Arkipäivien lisäksi käyntejä voi olla myös illalla sekä viikonloppuisin. Asiakassuhteet ovat pääosin pitkäaikaisia, joten tiedämme, kuinka tärkeää on, että avustajan ja asiakkaan kemiat kohtaavat.

**Me teemme työtä aina asiakkaan hyvinvointi edellä ja olemmekin siinä melkoisen hyviä: sisäpiirissä olevat sanoisivat, että pykälää parempia!** **Lupaammekin sinulle:**

- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen


- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi


- lähiesihenkilön tuen


- monipuolisen työnkuvan


- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan


- palkkaluokka on G16A eli palvelusvuosista riippuen 12,79–14,06 €/h (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)


**Sinä:**

Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, kenelle asiakkaan hyvinvointi tulee ykkösenä. Toivomme, että sinulla olisi aikaisempaa kokemusta erilaisten ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä. Tutkintoa tärkeämpää on palvelualttius sekä hyvät kommunikointitaidot. Ajokortti ja oma auto katsotaan eduksi, mutta ne eivät ole välttämättömiä. Tehtävään otettavan henkilön on esitettävä rikosrekisteriote, koska työ sisältää vammaisten ja ikäihmisten kanssa työskentelyä.

Kerrothan jo hakemuksessasi toiveistasi ja mieltymyksistäsi (esim. työajat, asiakasryhmät, sijainti, erityisosaaminen), jotta voimme kohdistaa sinulle mahdollisimman hyvin sopivia asiakkuuksia.

Otamme sinuun yhteyttä, kun profiiliasi ja hakemustasi vastaava asiakkuus löytyy.

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa**

Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Tampereella, Kuopiossa ja Joensuussa. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille.

Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään, ja uskomme että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. Jos uskot samaan ja haluat tulla mukaan, laita meille hakemus. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palveluesihenkilö Suvi Sokka-Lehtinen p. **040 357 1119**

description: Haetaan aurinkoista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä vastaanottovirkailijaa korkeatasoiseen kohteeseen. title: Matalapainepesijöitä, Low-pressure cleaners
description:
Haemme tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavia MATALAPAINEPESIJÖITÄ KAUHAJOELLE teurastamoon!

Tässä tehtävässä vastaat tuotantotilojen pesusta matalapainepesumenetelmillä teurastamossa korkeiden hygieniavaatimusten mukaisesti. Katsomme eduksesi aiemman työkokemuksen matalapainepesutehtävistä elintarviketuotantolaitoksessa. Etsimme ennen kaikkea tekijää, joka ei pelkää työntekoa ja kavahda teurastamoa työympäristönä. Saat meiltä kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään sekä monimuotoisen ja ammattimaisen työtiimin tueksesi.
Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava. Työvuorosi sijoittuvat arkipäivien iltavuoroon kello 15.00–00.00 välille. Huomaathan, että kohteeseen ei kulje hyvin julkista liikennettä , joten saatat tarvita autoa työmatkoihisi.
Tehtävästä maksetaan Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 5 mukaista palkkaa (14,58 €/h) sekä mahdolliset lisät.
Vaatimukset:

- Innostuneisuutta, asennetta ja heittäytymistä työhön.
- Hyvä fyysinen kunto.
- Hygieniapassi ja työturvallisuuskortti.
- Todennettu negatiivinen tulos salmonellatestistä.
- Suomen tai englannin kielen hyvä osaaminen.

Arvostamme:
- Oma-aloitteista ja tarkkaa työskentelytapaa sekä innokasta asennetta uuden oppimiseen.
- Halua tehdä ruumiillista työtä.
- Kokemusta ja/tai koulutusta elintarvikehygienia- tai puhtaanapitoalalta.
- Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä kohteeseen ei kulje hyvin julkista liikennettä.

Tarjoamme:

- Työn, jossa näet oman käden jäljen – työ on palkitsevaa.
- Paikan Suomen elintarvikehygienian puhdistuksen kärkipaikalla.
- Isona yrityksenä palkan, joka tulee ajallaan.
- Kattavan koulutusohjelman, jossa jatkokoulutamme sinusta alan ehdottoman ykkösosaajan.
- Mielenkiintoisen sekä muuttuvan työn, jossa pääset toteuttamaan omaa osaamista
- Huippu tiimin ja arvostuksen.
- Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta sen kaikissa merkityksissä, meidän tiimissämme voit olla oma itsesi. Ole osa jotain suurempaa tee merkityksellistä työtä, joka varmistaa asiakkaamme tuotantoprosessin toimivuuden joka päivä ja, että me kaikki kuluttajina saamme turvallista ja puhdasta ruokaa.


Hae oheisen linkin kautta viimeistään 6.10.2026.! Käsittelemme kaikki hakemukset ja kerromme jokaiselle hakijalle prosessin etenemisestä.

Apply through the link below by October 6, 2026! We will process all applications and inform each applicant about the progress of the process.

title: Software Engineering Productivity Lead
description:
We are looking for a passionate technologist to lead the ways of working across all of Bittium groups software development: about 300 developers building everything from firmware to web frontends. You will set the standard for how we build, review, test, document and ship software, and roll it out hands-on with the teams. You get real authority, direct access to R&D leadership and backing from group management.

You might be the person who

- argued the team into a better merge strategy, and was right.
- tried the new build tool the weekend it came out.
- replaced a team's creaking toolchain with something modern, and nobody wanted to go back.
- has been told no about a rewrite more than once.
- moved into a lead, architect or managerial role years ago and never stopped writing code or tinkering with the pipelines.
- has rolled a new way of working out across several teams, and knows the hard part was never the tooling.

If a couple of these sound like you, keep reading. Whether you are a senior engineer ready to take your first step into leading and owning change beyond your own team, or a leader who has done this before and still wants to get your hands dirty, this role is built for you.

What you will own

- You define what modern software engineering means at Bittium: the standard every team builds against, and you keep raising it as the industry moves.
- You set our group-wide engineering workflow: version control strategy, branching, code review and CI/CD, from commit to release, with room for what each product and team needs and built for agentic-first development.
- You decide the quality bar a release has to clear: what we require from test automation, documentation and review before software ships.
- You author an engineering handbook with our senior engineers: a practical guide to how we build software, clear enough that any team can pick it up and use it.
- You help shape how we measure engineering health.

Product teams choose the right technology for their product. You are the engineers' engineer: you define, and help build, the engineering infrastructure and ways of working they stand on: pipelines, quality gates, test and documentation tooling, ready to use and maintained like products. Adoption is supported, not dumped on the teams. The work does not end with the first rollout. The foundation keeps evolving, and you keep pushing it forward.

Your first six months

- Help write the first version of our engineering handbook: a practical guide to how we build software, in one place.
- Set the group's ways of working, starting with source control and CI/CD, with the first teams already building on it.
- Get the first shared pipeline, quality gates and documentation tooling live with real teams. Working, not a slide deck.
- Put the first release quality gates into production use.

Where we are headed

Our goal is simple: well-tested, well-documented software, built on a shared, modern development platform. Software development is shifting toward agentic workflows, and we want our codebases ready for that: modular, containerized and verifiable, so an agent can check one out, build it, run the tests and trust the result. You define what that readiness means in practice, together with our Head of AI. We are also investing heavily in hardware-in-the-loop test automation against real devices, and your standards set the bar there too.

What we ask

- A software engineering background strong enough to hold your own with our senior engineers.
- A track record of changing how teams work, whether as the engineer who pushed for better Git workflows and modern tooling and made it stick, or as the lead who ran that change across an organisation.
- Strong opinions and dirty hands. You prototype, build and fix things yourself, and you lead the change at the same time: you own the direction, carry it through and answer for the outcome.
- You know modern DevOps and the engineering platform behind it well: version control, CI/CD, test automation, developer documentation.
- Agentic software development has clicked for you. You work with coding agents daily, you see where this goes as agents take on whole tasks with less and less supervision, and you have opinions about what that demands from codebases, tests, environments and documentation.
- You can work across very different stacks. Ours include, among other things, C/C++, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, web frontends, embedded Linux and FPGA.
- Fluent Finnish and good English.
- Due to the nature of Bittiums business and our customers expectations, you are a Finnish citizen and able to pass security clearance conducted by the Finnish Security Intelligence Service (SUPO).

We do not count years of experience. Skill, will and passion decide.

What we offer

- Group-wide authority over engineering standards.
- Deep technology with real stakes, from military radios in national defence to ECG monitors in hospitals.
- Room to stay hands-on. Prototype, experiment, pick the best tools. IT supports the infrastructure.
- Hybrid work in Oulu, our headquarters software site, or Espoo. Flexible inside Finland. Competitive pay.

Interested?

Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

title: Civil/HVAC QA/QC Engineer for CAM Plant Project, Kotka
description:
We are looking for a Civil/ HVAC QA/QC Engineer to join our clients China Harbour Engineering Company Ltd. team for the Kotka CAM Plant project.

China Harbour Engineering Company Ltd. (CHEC) is a world-renowned international contractor and a leading provider of comprehensive services across the entire industrychain for both public and private sectors. CHEC has been engaged as the main contractor for the CAM Plant project in Kotka, responsible for the implementation and construction of the plant. The position is project-based, with an expected duration of approximately one year, and the work is located in Keltakallio, Kotka.

Your responsibilities include:

- Developing and implementing QA/QC procedures for structural and architectural works, including facades and fit-outs.
- Conducting site inspections to monitor the quality of materials, workmanship, and compliance with design specifications.
- Coordinating with construction teams, design consultants, and subcontractors to resolve quality-related issues.
- Preparing and maintain quality documentation, including ITPs, checklists, inspection records, and final handover documents.
- Ensuring all works meet Finnish regulatory standards and EU construction regulations.
- Assisting with permit compliance and project closeout procedures in accordance with Finnish authorities.
- Providing training and technical guidance to site personnel on QA/QC protocols and standards.
What we expect from you:

- Bachelors or masters degree in Civil Engineering, HVAC, or related discipline.
- Several years of experience in QA/QC roles for structural and architectural construction.
- Strong familiarity with Finnish building regulations, construction permit processes, and handover requirements.
- Good communication skills and strong coordination ability with design teams, contractors, and other stakeholders.
- Full professional proficiency in English.

The CAM Plant Project offers you a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in the green transition, and you will have the chance to develop professionally in a diverse and challengingenvironment.

The desired start date for the job is as soon as possible according to the agreement.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process or the role, please contact Barona Engineering Senior Consultant Katri Hyppänen at +358 50 439 9785. Available on Mon-Tue and Thu 10am-2pm. We will be interviewing applicants during the application period, so please apply for the position through the provided link. Kindly attach your English-language CV to your application. For privacy reasons, we do not accept applications via email or WhatsApp.

title: Workshop Assistant, Bluefors Oy
description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish technology company and a global leader in cryogenic measurement systems used in quantum computing research. Their Helsinki workshop is where precision materials meet cutting-edge science - and they need someone like you to keep it running.

As a Workshop Assistant, you'll handle real materials - copper, aluminium, brass, stainless steel - and cut them to exact measurements using modern ERP systems. Full training is provided, so you don't need prior experience to get started.

This is a full-time, fixed-term position (4 months) with day shifts and a 40-hour work week. It's a great entry point into industrial work at a company that genuinely stands out.

YOUR TASKS

You'll be working as a Workshop Assistant at Bluefors Oy's Helsinki facility, employed through Barona Teollisuus Oy. Your day-to-day work keeps the workshop stocked, organised, and running smoothly.

- Receiving, inspecting, and storing incoming raw materials
- Cutting materials - copper, stainless steel (AISI 316), brass, aluminium, and POM plastic - to specified dimensions using workshop tools
- Reading and following cutting instructions from the ERP system
- Maintaining accurate inventory records and stock levels
- Keeping the workshop tidy and organised
- Handling parts ranging from 12 mm to 360 mm in diameter

REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to follow precise technical instructions carefully and accurately
- Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for your tasks
- Good practical hands-on skills
- Willingness to learn - full training is provided

NICE TO HAVE

- Previous experience in a warehouse or industrial environment
- Forklift licence (trukkikortti)
- Familiarity with ERP systems or similar tools

You will be employed with Barona Teollisuus Oy for 4 month fixed-term employment contract. The work starts as agreed, no later than in the beginning of November. This is full-time position from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week in a day shift.

Apply via application form. We are handling the applications already before the application deadline closes and the role will be fulfilled as soon as the right candidate is found. Please note, that applications sent via email are not taken into account.

title: A la Carte Chef – Rovaniemi
description:
À la Carte Chef – Rovaniemi

The winter season in Lapland means a lively atmosphere, international guests and busy restaurant service. We are now looking for an **À la Carte Chef to join a restaurant team in Rovaniemi for the full winter season.**

You don't need to speak Finnish – **English is the working language in the kitchen.** What you do need is previous experience in an à la carte kitchen and the confidence to work efficiently during busy service.

What is the job like?

This is not just a short seasonal position. Work is available **from November until March**, with approximately **90 working hours per 3 weeks**.

You will be working in an à la carte kitchen as part of an international team. The winter season can get busy, so previous experience in a professional restaurant kitchen is important.

What are we looking for?

**À la carte experience, good English skills and a positive attitude towards work.**

You will also need a valid Hygiene Passport and the flexibility to work different shifts.

Salary is based on the **Finnish hospitality industry collective agreement and your previous experience**. Assistance with **accommodation** can also be provided if needed.

**Would you like to spend the winter working in Rovaniemi?**

Send us your application and tell us briefly about your previous kitchen experience.

**Applications: rekrytointi@duunaamo.fi**

title: LÄHIHOITAJIA yli 18v. omaishoidon vapaan sijaistukseen
description:
Etsimme nyt Lahden tiimiimme (Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueelle) lähihoitajia yli 18-vuotiaiden sekä yli 65-vuotiaiden omaishoidon vapaiden tuurauksiin. Omaishoitajan työtä tehdään suurella sydämellä, mutta työ on usein vaativaa ja omaishoitajakin tarvitsee hengähdystaukoja työstään. Työlläsi autat omaishoitajia jaksamaan ja huolehdit hoidettavasta omaishoitajan lakisääteisten vapaiden ajan. Työ on keikkaluontoista ja asiakkaat voivat vaihdella nuoresta aikuisesta iäkkäisiin. Asiakkainasi ovat oman osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan myös kehitysvammaiset ja muut erityistä tukea tarvitsevat. Emme kuitenkaan lähetä sinua kenen tahansa luokse, vaan saat itse valita asiakkaasi oman osaamisesi perusteella.

Meillä työskentelet asiakasperheissä, joiden asiakkuus kestää yksittäisistä vuoroista useisiin kuukausiin. Pääsääntöisesti yksi työvuoro kestää kerrallaan 2-4 tuntia 1-2 kertaa viikossa. Työtä on tarjolla arkisin klo 7-21 välillä, sekä lauantaisin klo 8-18 välillä. Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti asiakasperheidemme omissa kodeissa, sekä kotien ympäristössä esimerkiksi ulkoillen tai kaupassa asioiden.

Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä osaamista perheiden aitoon kohtaamiseen. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy ammatillista kokemusta joko iäkkäistä, vammaisista tai muuten erityistarpeisista asiakkaista. Meiltä saat myös kattavan perehdytyksen työhösi. Mikäli työ lapsiperheiden parissa kiinnostaa myös, kerrothan meille. Tarjoamme keikkaluontoista työtä myös alle 18-vuotiaiden omaishoidon vapaiden sijaistuksen ja lapsiperheiden kotipalvelun parissa!

title: BMS Project Manager for Datacenter Projects
description:
We are recruiting experienced BMS Project Manager for datacenter projects in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in high-profile critical infrastructure projects within a growing and technically demanding industry.

The assignment starts ASAP and is expected to continue for approximately 12 months.

The successful candidate can be employed under a fixed-term employment contract or engaged through a contractor agreement, depending on their situation and preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites
* Manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and risk management plans
* Oversee project financials, including cost control, forecasting, reporting, and margin management
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and project requirements
* Coordinate activities with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders
* Oversee procurement, logistics, and resource allocation across multiple sites
* Monitor project performance and provide regular project reporting
* Support commissioning, handover, and project close-out activities

What We Are Looking For:

* 5+ years of project management experience within construction, building services, automation, or related industries
* Demonstrated success managing complex, multidisciplinary projects
* Strong understanding of construction contracts, project controls, and safety legislation
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, and P&L responsibility
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Good written and spoken English communication skills
* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel between project sites within the Helsinki Metropolitan Area
* Valid right to work in Finland
* Valid Occupational Safety Card and Electrical Safety Card

Previous experience in datacenter construction projects will be considered a strong advantage. We also value building automation (BMS) knowledge and experience with platforms such as Metasys, EasyIO, Tridium Niagara, Trend, Siemens, Schneider Electric, or similar systems. Experience managing large-scale projects, working in regulated environments, and proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project or Primavera will further support success in this role.

PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certifications, as well as a degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Automation, or a related field, are considered advantageous.

Details:

The position is based in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area across multiple datacenter construction sites. The assignment starts ASAP and will last approximately 12 months.

Working hours are between Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm.

Interested?

Apply through the application link and submit your CV and salary expectations. A brief application letter is optional.

Apply as soon as possible, as interviews have already started and suitable candidates may be selected during the application period.

For data security reasons, we do not accept applications via email.

title: Project Scheduler
description:
CMS Construction Management Solutions Oy is looking for **Project Schedulers** for our client's industrial project in the Oulu region, Finland.

As a Project Scheduler, you will work as part of the project organization and be responsible for preparing, maintaining and monitoring project schedules. You will work closely with project management, site teams and other project parties to ensure that schedule information is up to date and that project progress can be effectively monitored and reported.

**Your responsibilities include**

- preparing, maintaining and updating project schedules

- monitoring project progress against the agreed schedule

- tracking key milestones, dependencies and critical paths

- identifying schedule deviations, delays and potential risks

- preparing schedule forecasts and progress reports

- collecting and coordinating schedule information from different project parties

- supporting the follow-up of work progress and upcoming activities

- reporting schedule status and relevant changes to the project organization

- working closely with project management, site teams and other project stakeholders


**We are looking for**

- previous experience in similar scheduling roles in industrial or construction projects

- experience with Primavera P6

- good understanding of project scheduling, dependencies and progress monitoring

- ability to analyze schedules and identify deviations and potential delays

- good IT and reporting skills

- good command of English

- a valid right to work in Finland


Accommodation and project-related travel can be arranged by CMS as agreed.

**Applicants must have valid rights to work in Finland.**

**Location:** Oulu, Finland

**Start:** 10/2026 & 01/2027

**Estimated duration:** approximately 2 years

description:

title: Sled dog guide, Lapland Husky Safaris Luosto
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for sled dog guides for the winter season 2026–2027 for Lapland Husky Safaris Luosto.**

Our kennel is a middle-sized husky kennel so there is for sure sound and hustle during the winter season! Our kennel is a home to a pack of approximately 200 dogs who will be your daily workmates as well as your 15 human colleagues. Our guests arrive mainly from around Europe, and in December most of them come from the UK. Huskysafari is one of the most anticipated excursions of international guests during their holiday in Lapland!

We are looking for brisk, active and customer service-oriented Sled dog guides to do kennel and guide work. If you are cheerful, flexible, and a multi-talent who is not afraid of physical work, this work could be for you. Furthermore, if you get along well with people and dogs, you can communicate in English fluently and like to work outside regardless of the weather, then for sure you are the person we are looking for. A good knowledge of French in particular, is considered an advantage.

Your tasks include taking care of the dogs, daily work at the kennel, guiding safaris and possibly route maintenance. Kennel work includes taking care of the dogs well-being, feeding and watering them, socializing the puppies, and daily cleaning of the kennels. Guiding work includes preparation of the safaris and dismantling tasks after the program, customer service at the kennel and in the terrain during the safari and guiding dog sledges. In Luosto everyone does everything!

To fully succeed at this work, you need flexibility towards work hours, pressure tolerance to handle rush and changing situations, and good physical condition. At least a class B drivers license is required for the job and experience driving a snowmobile is considered an advantage. Our safaris are led by a snowmobile, and our guests drive their dog sleds themselves. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement**

We organize first aid training for our employees at the beginning of the season but previously acquired first aid skills are considered an advantage. Previous experience in guide work, outdoor work in winter conditions, regional knowledge and experience working with dogs are also considered as an advantage. Most important thing is a realistic understanding of the demands of the work, especially its physical nature, but also the rewarding nature of the work.

**We offer you:**

- A great team and international work environment

- Variable work tasks and working days in pure air

- Brilliant recreation possibilities in Pyhä – Luosto area

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and last until the end of winter season (March) 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, hourly wage starting from 11,30 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation will be organized, with a reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

**Having your own car is necessary to transfer between accommodation and work.**

Please note that Lapland Husky Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Applications will be processed starting in week 32 in August. Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: luosto@laplandhuskysafaris.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

title: Car Driver, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Car Drivers for the Christmas season 2026 to Lapland Safaris offices in Levi and Saariselkä.**

Please note that we are currently accepting applications **only from candidates who already have the right to work in Finland.** Unfortunately, due to the processing times for work permits and the schedule of our recruitment, we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require a new work permit to work in Finland. **This includes applicants from the UK, Australia, and other non-EU countries who do not already hold a valid right to work in Finland.**

The duties of a Lapland Safaris driver mainly consist of transporting, loading, and collecting equipment bags containing our guests winter clothing from local hotels and Lapland Safaris locations. In addition, your tasks will include supporting safari operations, such as sorting, maintaining, and drying equipment. Due to long distances, you may also occasionally transport staff between different locations, or between the workplace and staff accommodation.

The vehicles you drive will vary from passenger cars to vans, 9seat minibuses, and even vans equipped with a tail lift that can be driven with a category B driving license. Our working language is English, so good English skills is considered an advantage.

In addition to a valid driving license, we expect flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, as your workdays may sometimes be long. You are the person we are looking for if you are hardworking, proactive, well organized, and reliable.

The work is physically demanding and partly carried out in challenging weather conditions, including Laplands winds and snowstorms. You will work as part of a larger equipment maintenance team, and your contribution is highly important to the operation of Lapland Safaris.

**We offer you:**

- A great team to work with

- The beautiful landscapes of Lapland

- An easy way to start working in the field of tourism in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits from Lapland Hotels & Safaris, including discounts on equipment rental, restaurants, and lift tickets at Lapland Ski Resorts.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. The work starts in mid-to-late November and is expected to last until the last week of December.

. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 11,30 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish public holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews and selections will be conducted already during the application period, so please apply soon! Positions will be filled as suitable candidates are found.

**More information:** info@laplandstaff.fi

title: Laboratory Test Engineer
description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field?*
- Do you have at least 3 years of experience working with power systems, electrical installations, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you previously led or participated in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) or customer approval testing for protection or automation systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with real-time simulation tools such as RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT?*
- Do you have experience using relay testing equipment such as Omicron test sets or similar protection testing devices?*
- Do you have experience with PSCAD or similar power system simulation software?*

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

Location: Vaasa, Finland (four days on-site)
Allocation: 100 %
Start date: Around October-November
End date: Initial 12-month contract
Language: Fluent in English

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

description:
We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions
- Improving engineering productivity and processes through AI
- Creating competitive advantage through Marine-specific AI applications

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

This position can be based in Turku or Espoo. Please let us know your preferred location in your application.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant educational background
- Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, and AIOps
- Hands-on experience in developing and implementing AI solutions
- Experience in maritime, shipbuilding, engineering, CAD/CAE, PLM, or other industrial environments is an advantage
- Ability to turn business and engineering needs into practical technical solutions
- Understanding of software development, system architectures, integrations, and data flows

title: Legal Counsel @ Enity Bank Group
description:
Are you a curious and solution-oriented lawyer looking to further develop your expertise in the banking sector? Are you interested in working for a Nasdaq Stockholm-listed Nordic banking group with an innovative and friendly culture?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Enity Bank Group's Finnish branch** as a new **Legal Counsel**! This is a broad in-house role where you will be the key legal point of contact for Enity Bank Group's Finnish operations, while working closely with the wider legal team across the Nordic organisation. You will be the sole lawyer in Finland, while having the support of your legal colleagues across the Nordics whenever needed.

_Enity believes in people's potential and is challenging the Nordic mortgage market by making banking more inclusive, sustainable and human. As a listed company, Enity operates through the brands Bluestep Bank, Bank2 and 60plusbanken, offering mortgages to customers often excluded by traditional banks – for example, due to self-employment, type of employment, age or credit history – as well as savings products. The Group operates across Sweden, Norway and Finland and is entering its next phase of growth, with an ambition to develop through new products, partnerships, distribution models and M&A. In Finland, Enity operates through a local branch of Enity Bank Group AB (publ)._

**In this role**, you will support the Finnish business on a wide range of legal and regulatory matters, with a particular focus on mortgage lending, consumer credit and the day-to-day legal needs of the branch. The role offers significant independence and close interaction with both the local business and colleagues across the Group. In more concrete terms, you will:

- provide legal advice to the Finnish branch on a broad range of matters

- support the mortgage business on matters relating to lending, security, property law, consumer protection, debt collection and insolvency

- review marketing materials and customer communications from a legal and regulatory perspective

- review and negotiate commercial agreements

- support the business in relation to customer matters, complaints and disputes

- monitor relevant Finnish legislation and regulatory developments and support their implementation within the branch

- advise on regulatory requirements applicable to the Finnish operations and support interactions with relevant authorities when needed

- prepare internal legal guidance and training

- support the Group in connection with potential acquisitions and other strategic transactions, including legal due diligence, transaction documentation and integration-related matters


The position is based in Helsinki and reports to the Bank's CLO, who is based in Stockholm. You will be part of the Nordic Legal team and collaborate closely with legal colleagues across the Group. In Finland, you will act as the main legal point of contact for the local organisation and work closely with the Branch Manager for Finland, contributing to the continued development and growth of Enity Bank Group's business in Finland.

**This role would be ideal for a legal professional who:**

- has a Finnish master's degree in law and at least three years of relevant post-qualification experience (however this is just the minimum requirement, and the role has plenty to offer a more senior lawyer as well) preferably from a bank, financial institution, law firm or other regulated business;

- has experience from one or more of the following areas: banking and finance, mortgage lending or other consumer credit, consumer protection, insolvency, debt collection or disputes or financial regulation;

- is comfortable taking ownership of matters and working independently, while also collaborating closely with colleagues across different functions and jurisdictions;

- can translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear, practical advice and is interested in understanding the commercial context in which you work; and

- has excellent communication skills in Finnish and English. Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.


**Enity Bank Group offers you:**

- a versatile position with excellent opportunities for professional growth;

- a front row seat in a growing company, where you have the opportunity to influence and gain responsibility;

- a supportive and close-knit culture with shared moments, such as after-works, company get-togethers and events; and

- the possibility to travel occasionally and to work as a part of a Nordic team with colleagues in Stockholm and Oslo.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **5 October 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi). We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period, so don't wait to apply!

title: Apulaisravintolapäällikkö
description:
Lillan Hotel & Kök kasvaa ja kehittyy – nyt sinulla on mahdollisuus tulla mukaan rakentamaan sen menestystä seuraavassa tarinan luvussa!

Olemme viiden pienosakkaan omistama, Tampereen ainoa boutique-hotelli sekä monipuolinen ja laadukas ravintola, jossa yhdistyvät kodinomaisuus, lämmin ylellisyys ja henkilökohtainen, läsnäoleva palvelu. Yritys tunnetaan vahvasta kasvusta sekä modernista ja kannattavasta toimintamallista, joka nojaa strategiseen johtamiseen, jatkuvaan kehittämiseen ja korkeaan asiakastyytyväisyyteen. Etsimme apulaisravintolapäällikköä toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vastaamaan ravintolamme operatiivisesta toiminnasta, henkilöstön johtamisesta sekä kehittämään asiakaskokemusta yhdessä sitoutuneen tiimin ja esihenkilöiden kanssa.

Apulaisravintolapäällikkönä vastaat ravintolan päivittäisestä operatiivisesta toiminnasta, henkilöstön johtamisesta, perehdyttämisestä ja työvuorosuunnittelusta, asiakaskokemuksen ja palvelun laadun varmistamisesta, ravintolapalveluiden, tapahtumien ja tilaisuuksien johtamisesta, niiden ja tuotteidemme kehittämisestä yhteistyössä johtotiimin kanssa sekä taloudellisesta työskentelystä, myynnin ja kannattavuuden kehityksestä. Myös toimintaympäristön ja tilojen kunnossapito sekä työsuojeluvelvoitteiden ja viranomaisvaatimusten noudattaminen ovat osa päivittäistä työskentelyäsi.

Etsimme sinua, joka omaat vahvaa kokemusta ravintola-alan esihenkilö- tai johtotehtävistä Johdat henkilöstöä vahvalla organisointikyvyllä, vastuullisuudella ja vahvistaen koko tiimiä. Vastuullista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta, sekä vahvaa asiakaspalvelu- ja palveluliiketoiminnan ymmärrystä. Ymmärrät taloudellisen johtamisen ja yhdistät sen laadukkaisiin palveluihin ja asiakaskokemuksiin. Puhut sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kieltä.

Eduksi katsotaan aiempaa kokemusta hotelli- ja/tai ravintolaympäristössä työskentelystä sekä intohimoa pienten elämysten luomiseen kaikissa palveluissamme, ruoka- ja juomatuotteita ja tapahtumia kohtaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle näköalapaikan ja vahvan roolin kasvavassa, modernia palvelualan toimintaa ja kannattavaa liiketoimintaa tuottavassa yrityksessämme. Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa, kehittää ja jättää jälkesi ainutlaatuiseen konseptiin, inspiroivan työympäristön poikkeuksellisessa ja historiallisessa miljöössä sekä ammattitaitoisen ja motivoituneen työyhteisön, yrityksemme resurssit ja kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksen mukaan.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si osoitteeseen operatiiviselle johtajallemme lasse@lillan.fi tai toimitusjohtajallemme mirella@lillan.fi viimeistään 23.10.

Hakemuksia käsitellään hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään sopivan hakijan löydyttyä.

title: Asumisen avustaja, Riihitien palvelukoti, Liperi
description:
**Asumisen avustaja, Riihitien palvelukoti, Liperi**

Pidätkö ruoanlaitosta, siivoamisesta ja viihtyisän ympäristön luomisesta? Haluatko tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten päivittäisessä elämässä?

Haemme **asumisen avustajaa Riihitien palvelukotiin Liperiin** määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen (vähintään 29.11.2026 saakka)**.**

Riihitie on koti 12 kehitysvammaiselle aikuiselle, jotka elävät jokainen omannäköistään elämää turvallisesti ja tuetusti. Asumisen avustajana olet tärkeä osa työyhteisöämme ja asukkaidemme arkea.

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Asumisen avustajana vastaat yksikön arjen tukitoiminnoista. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- ruoan valmistamista ja muita ruokahuollon tehtäviä


- tekstiilihuoltoa, esim. pyykinpesua


- yksikön puhtaanapitoa


Asukkaat saattavat joskus tarjoutua avuksesi tehtäviisi tai tulla rupattelemaan. Sinun ei tarvitse toimia ohjaajana, mutta osallistut ohjaajien rinnalla asukkaiden viihtyisän ja turvallisen arjen mahdollistamiseen.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

Toivomme, että olet oma-aloitteinen, vastuullinen ja kohtaat ihmiset arvostavasti.

Tehtävässä tarvitset:

- soveltuvan koulutuksen (esim. hoiva-avustajan tutkinto) tai aikaisemman kokemuksen kautta hankitun osaamisen tehtävään (esim. kokemus vastaavista tukitehtävistä ja/tai kehitysvamma-alalta)


- hygieniapassin ja elintarviketyötä tekevän terveydentilaselvityksen


- hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja suomen kielen taidon


- kiinnostusta työskennellä kehitysvammaisten henkilöiden kanssa.


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- määräaikaisen työsuhteen vähintään 29.11.2026 asti sekä säännölliset arkipäiviin sijoittuvat työvuorot


- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisen palkan (palkkaluokka G16A/G18B koulutustaustan mukaan)


- merkityksellisen työn osana asumispalveluiden arkea


- työyhteisön tuen ja perehdytyksen tehtäviisi


- mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omia vahvuuksiasi ja osaamistasi.


**Tule toteuttamaan hyvää arkea**

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 11.10.2026 osoitteeseen rekrytointi@hl-s.fi tai käyttäen verkkosivujemme hakulomaketta (https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/). Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään pikaisesti, heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palvelukotivastaava Kirsi Juvonen, puh. 050 388 6639.

_Tule mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme pykälää parempaa arkea. Honkalampi-säätiössä teemme työtä, jotta kenenkään unelmat eivät jäisi olosuhteiden tai tuen puutteen vuoksi toteutumatta. Meillä johtaminen tapahtuu arjessa ja ihmisten keskellä – meillä koti on koti._

title: Business Controller, Vianor
description:
Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

We are looking for a Business Controller, Vianor to join our team.

The Business Controller, Vianor acts as a senior finance business partner to the Vianor business leadership, providing financial insight, analysis and challenge to support performance management, profitability improvement and strategic decision-making. The role combines strong business understanding, disciplined financial planning and reporting, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear business actions.

Key responsibilities:

- ·Financial leadership and business partnering: Provide proactive financial support, challenge and insights to Vianor business leadership and country organizations. Act as a trusted sparring partner in identifying performance drivers, risks, opportunities and concrete improvement actions.
- Performance management and profitability analysis: Lead analysis of business performance across sales, margin, cost, operating profit, working capital and cash flow. Support the business in understanding key profitability drivers, including customer, product, country and price-volume-mix dynamics.
- Planning, forecasting and budgeting: Own and coordinate key financial planning processes for Vianor, including monthly estimates, annual budgeting and long-range planning, in close cooperation with business leadership and country finance teams.
- Reporting and financial transparency: Ensure timely, accurate and meaningful financial reporting for Vianor and support country companies in monthly reporting. Continuously improve reporting quality, management insight and visualization of key financial information.
- Investment, business case and strategic support: Support business development, investment decisions, expansion initiatives and M&A-related activities by providing robust financial analysis, business case modelling and standardized evaluation methods.
- Process, tools and ways-of-working development: Drive continuous improvement of financial processes, planning practices, reporting tools and analytical methods. Promote efficient use of systems, data and digital tools, including business intelligence and AI-supported analysis.
- Governance, controls and audit support: Support sound financial governance, internal cost allocation, inventory-related follow-up and audit processes for Vianor and relevant country companies.

What we expect from you:

- A masters degree, preferably in finance, accounting or economics.
- Solid experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis, reporting or a comparable senior finance role, preferably in an international, multi-entity environment.
- Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, profitability drivers and financial performance management.
- Proven ability to act as a business partner to senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and convert financial analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Experience in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, investment analysis and business case modelling.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for business audiences.
- High level of integrity, ownership and attention to detail, combined with the ability to operate independently and drive improvement across processes, tools and ways of working.
- Good command of modern finance systems, reporting tools and data analytics solutions; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.
- Fluent written and spoken Finnish and English. Other relevant languages are considered an advantage.

The successful candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial curiosity and a hands-on understanding of business operations. They are expected to be proactive, structured and collaborative, with the confidence to challenge the business constructively while building trust-based relationships across functions and countries.

Our way of working

Our talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.

Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?

Please send the application, including your CV and salary request by 11th October 2026.

For further information, please contact: Timo Koponen,e-mail timo.koponen@nokiantyres.com.

title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

title: Senior Product Manager for BeeHealthy, Finland / Germany
description:
Senior Product Manager, BeeHealthy

Join us in our mission to make care smarter!

At BeeHealthy, we're on a mission to make care smarter through our configurable, white-label SaaS platform. We combine over 115 years of healthcare expertise with modern technology, serving social, healthcare, and veterinary providers alongside insurance organisations in over 10 countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

We're a team of 90+, with 60+ in our product organisation, growing fast and looking for people who want to do meaningful work. If you care about impact, quality, and building products that genuinely improve how care is delivered and received, we'd love to hear from you.

Location: Helsinki, Turku, Tampere, or Jyväskylä (Finland) or Berlin (Germany)
Working mode: Remote-friendly, hybrid working model

About the Role
You will own the what and the why for your product area, from discovery through launch and iteration. You will work closely with Engineering and Design to turn strategy into a clear product direction, make the tough calls on scope and tradeoffs, and ensure teams build the right things. This role is a strong fit for someone with a technical background who wants to build product in healthcare: a regulated, complex industry that runs on both B2B and B2C dynamics at once.

We are a company of about 100 people, and everyone here operates with a business owner mindset. Even at senior level, this role stays hands-on: you are accountable for the outcome, not just the output, and you build alongside the team rather than direct from a distance.

What you will do
Own the product strategy for your area, contributing to the bigger goal of making healthcare smarter
Stay on top of market knowledge, competitors, and the wider healthcare structure, so your decisions hold up commercially, not just technically
Run the end-to-end product management process for your domain, from discovery to delivery to feedback loops
Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, and commercial teams, turning customer insight into a roadmap the whole group can align behind
Work as a technical partner to engineering: understand the trade-offs, and use that understanding to push for product decisions that add real user value, not just ship features
Build compliance into the product from the start, working with frameworks like GDPR, MDR, EHDS, and national health data regulations, so requirements don't cost you rework or slip your timelines later

What you bring
5+ years in product management at a SaaS company, ideally already at senior level
Real comfort working close to engineering: APIs, integrations, platform architecture. Prior experience on a core platform team or in a highly technical environment is a strong plus
Solid product management craft, with experience in B2B
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
A natural team player: humble, hands-on, high energy, drawn to solving problems rather than just describing them
Fluent English, with the ability to express yourself clearly and present confidently to different audiences

Bonus points
Background in Fintech, Healthcare, or Gambling/Gaming, or another complex, highly regulated industry
Experience across B2B2C environments; direct experience building or significantly evolving a CRM platform is a strong plus
Experience in a scale-up
Exposure to healthcare products such as Epic/MyChart or similar patient portal / EHR platforms
Experience with authentication or identity systems (OIDC, SAML, OAuth 2.0)
International experience, having worked across multiple markets or countries
German, Italian, Spanish, Arabic, or other languages

Benefits
Generous, Nordic-style paid holiday
Flexible remote-work policy and working hours
Wide range of IT equipment to choose from
Comprehensive occupational healthcare
Sponsored sports or culture memberships
Healthy snacks, and drinks at the office
Regular team days, game nights, and social events

Culture at BeeHealthy
At BeeHealthy, freedom and responsibility go hand in hand. You'll be trusted to work independently while collaborating closely with your colleagues, sharing knowledge, learning continuously, and respecting each other both professionally and personally.
Our culture is guided by strong values:
Skill and Knowledge: we never stop learning.
Caring and Responsibility: we look out for each other and the people who use what we build.
Partners and Entrepreneurship: we innovate through collaboration.
Growth and Development: we're committed to unlocking potential, both for ourselves and our customers.

We're a close-knit, international team where talent and knowledge-sharing thrive. We believe that building great healthcare technology starts with taking care of the people who build it.

Recruitment process
