title: Solution architect - BIltema
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION AND THE COMPANY

With a wide range of products for the entire family, Biltema is a strong brand with more than 160 stores across the Nordic region and plans for further expansion. The success and vision are based on a simple concept that has been refined over the years; To make it economically easier for people to have cars, boats, homes, tools, and leisure articles of high quality, thereby creating a richer leisure time for these people. They choose their own path and have therefore decided to invest in their own operations and development of systems and technical solutions, among other things. Biltema Nordic Services is a service company within Biltema with various departments that together deliver a complete solution for the department stores' assortment and operations. The IT department in Helsingborg provides systems and digital solutions in collaboration with Biltema's other companies within the group for our Nordic markets.

We are looking for a Solution Architect to translate business needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions across our international organization.

Working closely with the Enterprise Architecture team, business stakeholders, project managers, and technical teams, you will own solution architecture from initial assessment through implementation and operational handover. You will ensure that projects align with our enterprise architecture principles, technology roadmap, security requirements, and operational capabilities.

YOU ARE OFFERED

    

To work for a company with healthy values and play an important role in the future development of Biltema's systems.

    

Work in an organization with clear leadership and a clear and long-term vision.

    

The opportunity to work at a well-managed and very prosperous company that values entrepreneurship and simplicity.

EXAMPLES OF WORK TASKS

    

Own end-to-end solution architecture for assigned projects, from business requirements through design, implementation and operational handover

    

Design secure, scalable solutions across Azure and on-premises environments, including identity, data flows and non-functional requirements

    

Define integration approaches between ERP platforms (Dynamics 365 and AX), business applications and data platforms

    

Apply enterprise architecture standards, prepare proposals for architecture reviews, and flag risks, technical debt and exceptions early

    

Embed security and privacy in every design, including threat modeling and production readiness

    

Lead workshops with business stakeholders, delivery teams and vendors, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences

    

Assess vendor proposals and challenge unnecessary complexity or long-term dependency

EXPERIENCE

    

Significant experience in solution architecture or a comparable role, with ownership of complex solutions in an enterprise environment.

    

Demonstrated ability to take solutions from business requirements through design, implementation, and operational transition.

    

Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud architecture.

    

Experience designing integrations across enterprise applications, including APIs, messaging, events, and data exchanges.

    

Working knowledge of identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, authentication, and authorization.

    

Ability to define non-functional requirements and make informed decisions about resilience, performance, security, and cost.

    

Experience working with project managers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, developers, security teams, and external suppliers.

    

Strong architectural documentation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder communication skills.

    

Experience working within architecture governance and Agile delivery practices.

    

Professional fluency in English and the ability to collaborate across countries and time zones.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Start: By agreement

Working hours: Standard office hours with the possibility for hybrid work.

Location: Helsingborg

Type of employment: This assignment is a recruitment, and the employment will be directly with our client. Salary, terms, and conditions are discussed separately.

The recruitment process is managed by A-hub. Therefore, Biltema Nordic Services requests that all inquiries regarding the position be directed to A-Hub.

title: Driftsansvarig till Joe Getaway Siljan
description:
Joe Getaway kommer till Siljan!

title: Head of Engineering at Cebon Industrial
description:
Would you like to combine strategic leadership with in-depth technical expertise in batteries and energy solutions? Cebon Industrial is now looking for a Head of Engineering to lead and further develop the company’s Engineering function while remaining hands-on in technically complex customer projects.

ABOUT CEBON INDUSTRIAL:

Cebon Industrial is one of four business units within Cebon Group, offering integrated battery cells and customised battery packs for industrial OEM applications across the European market.

The business is undergoing a strategic transformation, with the ambition of evolving from a distributor of customised battery cells into a full-service provider of industrial battery and energy solutions. With local Engineering and assembly expertise in Europe, Cebon Industrial can provide customers with broad, integrated support – from technical advice and development to complete solutions.

The business unit consists of more than 20 specialists and is supported by Cebon Group’s central functions within areas such as regulatory compliance, logistics and quality management.

Cebon Group was founded in Gothenburg in 1986 by three high school entrepreneurs who remain active in the company today. The Group develops and provides safety and energy solutions for both consumer and industrial markets. Its portfolio includes well-known brands such as GP Batteries, Housegard, CGS, Aqiila, Brentz and Sparq.

The Group has approximately 160 employees, annual revenue of around SEK 1 billion and operations across the Nordics, Italy, France, the Benelux region and the DACH region. Its headquarters and largest warehouse are located in Gothenburg, with an additional warehouse in the Netherlands. Cebon combines a strong commercial focus with a family-oriented and entrepreneurial culture.

Learn more at www.cebon.com.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Head of Engineering – Battery & Energy Solutions, you will be responsible for leading and developing Cebon Industrial’s Engineering function. While the team currently consists of one engineer, you will play a key role in building and expanding the function as the business continues to grow. As the company’s technical expert within battery and energy solutions, you will help shape its technical direction and support its continued growth. The role combines strategic responsibility with hands-on, operational leadership. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, suppliers and customers across the European Group. As Head of Engineering, you will set the technical direction, develop the team’s ways of working and ensure that customer needs are translated into sustainable, scalable and commercially viable solutions. Monthly travel within Europe is part of the role.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Leading and developing the Engineering team, including its priorities and ways of working.
    Defining the technical roadmap and monitoring developments within batteries, BMS, chargers, power electronics and energy storage.
    Leading technical activities in OEM projects, from requirements definition through to implementation.
    Translating customer requirements into system architectures, technical specifications and feasible solutions.
    Supporting the Sales and Product organisations in customer discussions, tenders, product development and supplier selection.
    Driving technical evaluations and make-or-buy decisions.
    Ensuring quality, regulatory compliance and risk management while developing the Engineering function’s processes and tools.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

    Has a strong technical background within batteries, battery technologies, power electronics or related industrial energy applications.
    Has experience leading other engineers, either formally or informally, and driving technical projects. You may already have some leadership experience and are eager to grow into a broader leadership role.
    Has worked in a customer-driven organisation or on projects involving OEM customers.
    Has experience translating complex technical requirements into structured and scalable solutions.
    Is confident making decisions in complex environments and comfortable challenging both suppliers and internal stakeholders.
    Communicates fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

We believe that you combine strong technical expertise with sound commercial understanding and enjoy working closely with customers, Sales and Product Management. You are structured, proactive and accountable, with a natural ability to lead and bring others forward. You are motivated to continue developing your leadership skills and take on broader responsibility over time.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYMENT:

This is a direct recruitment, meaning that you will be employed directly by Cebon Industrial. Cebon is collaborating with Friday on this recruitment process.

OTHER INFORMATION:

    Scope: Full-time.
    Location: Gothenburg.
    Start date: As agreed.
    Recruitment process: An initial interview with Friday, followed by interviews with Cebon.

Apply by clicking the link below. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. The position may be removed before it has been filled if the process has progressed to the selection and interview stage.

ABOUT FRIDAY:

At Friday, we are passionate about giving you as a tech professional the best possible opportunities in your career. By listening to your ambitions and what motivates you, we match you with companies and opportunities that make you look forward to going to work.

We place great value on ambition and potential and actively promote an inclusive, unbiased recruitment process in which everyone is given the same opportunity to succeed. We have offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Every year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and match candidates with organisations ranging from global companies to innovative start-ups.

title: Critical Environment CMMS Technician
description:
Overview

As a Critical Environment CMMS Technician, you will support the operational integrity of Microsoft’s datacenters by managing maintenance systems, coordinating vendors, supporting procurement activities, and ensuring compliance with maintenance and operational standards.

You will serve as the primary owner of the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), ensuring preventive and corrective maintenance activities are accurately scheduled, tracked, documented, and completed. Working closely with technicians, operations teams, and external vendors, you will help maintain accurate asset data, work orders, purchase orders, maintenance plans, and compliance records.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team powers the infrastructure behind services such as Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Bing. Our global portfolio spans more than 400 datacenters across 32 countries, supporting billions of customers and millions of businesses worldwide.

At Microsoft, we embrace a growth mindset, value collaboration, and are committed to empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

Responsibilities

    Build, manage, and maintain Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) schedules within the CMMS, ensuring alignment with Critical Environment standards.
    Serve as the primary point of contact for CMMS-related support, guidance, and issue resolution.
    Provide training and support to operational teams on CMMS processes, standards, and best practices.
    Ensure consistent CMMS utilization and data management practices across the campus.
    Monitor system performance, data quality, compliance, and maintenance record accuracy.
    Generate and communicate CMMS performance metrics and KPIs to Datacenter management.
    Identify compliance risks, process gaps, and opportunities for operational improvement.
    Analyse maintenance and asset data to identify trends, risks, and optimisation opportunities.
    Develop and maintain maintenance plans and task schedules within the CMMS.
    Manage asset, equipment, location, and inventory records to ensure system accuracy.
    Coordinate procurement activities, including reviewing quotations, creating purchase orders, tracking deliveries, recording receipts, and processing invoices.
    Monitor compliance and operational performance through Power BI dashboards and reporting tools.
    Ensure processes, documentation, and systems remain aligned with current operational standards and requirements.
    Provide administrative support to technicians, including ticket creation, tracking, and system updates.
    Support vendor onboarding activities, ensuring all required documentation and registrations are completed.
    Coordinate and schedule third-party preventive maintenance activities and vendor service visits.
    Maintain a strong focus on safety, security, compliance, and quality while carrying out all responsibilities.
    Embody Microsoft’s culture and values in all aspects of work.

Required Qualifications

    Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) or similar work order management platform.
    Understanding of maintenance workflows and work order lifecycle management.
    Strong organisational, coordination, and communication skills with high attention to detail.
    Demonstrated commitment to safety, compliance, quality, and accountability.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
    Proactive and collaborative approach with strong stakeholder management skills.
    Experience working with operational processes, documentation, data management, and Microsoft 365 tools.
    Continuous improvement mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

    Experience working in Datacenter Operations, Critical Environments, or other mission-critical facilities.
    Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, and maintenance service providers.
    Experience supporting asset management, inventory management, procurement, or facilities operations.
    High School Diploma, Technical Trade Certification (Electrical, HVAC, Mechanical, Marine Engineering, or similar), or equivalent practical experience.
    Experience in high-availability or critical infrastructure environments such as datacenters, hospitals, manufacturing, pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, oil and gas, or related industries.

Background Check Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role.

This position requires successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Software Engineer within Automotive
description:
Want to build automotive software where correctness, timing, and safety matter? Join technically demanding projects in ADAS, electrification, and connected vehicles.

You will develop embedded software for systems with complex interactions and strict requirements for performance, reliability, and functional safety. The work is hands-on, with opportunities to influence architecture, design decisions, and technical direction.

Depending on the assignment, you may:

    

develop safety-critical embedded software in C and C++

    

work close to the operating system using RTOS, Linux, or QNX

    

debug and optimize systems with critical timing and resource constraints

    

collaborate with systems engineers, testers, and hardware teams to ensure end-to-end functionality

    

contribute to software architecture, technical decisions, testing, and quality assurance

Many assignments involve AUTOSAR and ASPICE, where traceability, testing, and structured quality processes are integral to development.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

    

several years of experience in embedded software development or automotive software

    

solid knowledge of C and C++

    

a strong understanding of embedded systems and low-level behavior

    

experience working with RTOS, Linux, QNX, or a similar environment

    

the ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across software, systems, testing, and hardware disciplines

Preferred qualifications

Experience with AUTOSAR, ASPICE, automotive communication protocols, or tools from Vector is valuable. Knowledge of Rust is also a plus.

Fluency in Swedish is beneficial for some assignments.

What can you expect from us?

You will work on technically challenging assignments that allow you to deepen your expertise, influence technical direction, and continue growing as an engineer. Rather than working alone in customer projects, you will have opportunities to join teams with experienced colleagues in embedded and automotive systems.

A close local team provides day-to-day support and knowledge sharing, while Knowit’s broader network connects you with expertise across technologies and industries.

Application

Let’s start a conversation. We would be happy to tell you more about our projects, how we work, and what you would like to take on next.

About Knowit

Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.

Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.

We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

title: Raw Materials Specialist
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

The future is here. At Volvo Group, we are taking the knowledge from building vehicles, automotive systems and creating new technology that will not only make our cities less noisy and polluted, but also change the world of construction forever. If you would like to be part of this change journey, we would like you to join us. Read on…

This is us, your new colleagues

We are part of business controlling at Volvo Trucks Technology and Industrial. We develop and deploy raw material market expertise, tools, methods, and governance. These enable the Volvo Group to secure and enhance its raw material-related performance and thus provide a competitive advantage to its brands.

Our team is globally spread across Asia, Europe and the Americas and is considered a center of excellence on raw material (commodity) markets. As part of our scope today, we cover various materials like flat steel, ferrous castings, forging steel, base metals, precious metals, plastics, rubber, battery materials, energy etc. Our expertise is used to support and ensure Volvo Group’s competitiveness and eventually our customers’ success. Working together in a global team is a great opportunity for some interesting cross-cultural experiences.

What you will do ?

Now, we have an opening and are looking for a person to join our team of commodity market analysts for battery materials & base metals. This position is to be the knowledge center on the raw material market for battery materials and base metals across our major geographies i.e., Europe & Americas primarily but also Asia.  

As part of the job, you will consolidate and use all internal and external business intelligence available to understand the position/influence of different related factors in the commodity market. Based on identified, reliable business intelligence you will provide periodic market forecasts. You will on a regular basis support buyers in negotiation, participate in cost workshops, supply chain activities, and provide contractual guidance to the Volvo Group Purchasing organization. Keeping sustainability in perspective on these commodities, is key. You will contribute as needed to the segment strategies within Trucks Technology and Industrial and you will work closely with the Purchasing team.

In this position you will be part of the raw material business controlling team and report to the head of raw material.  

Who are you ?

We believe it is the right mindset that will make a difference within our organization. We are looking for a person who understands that the key to success is curiosity. A person who is able to look at the bigger picture, as well as go down in details when needed. To be successful in this position you need to have/build solid business acumen together with cross-functional networking agility. Teamwork, collaboration & cross-cultural sensitivity are key to succeed in this position. As we are a global and diverse team, all our meetings and e-mails will be in English, hence you need to be fluent in both speaking and writing in English.  

To be successful in your new role it’d be helpful if you had the following knowledge/experience:

    University/Master’s degree in science, engineering, economics or finance
    Analytical & critical thinking
    Ability to work efficiently independently as well as in a team
    Commodity market knowledge/experience in battery materials/base metals



Are we a perfect match?

We can’t promise you an effortless job, but what we can promise you are some skilled colleagues and truly exciting challenges to work with. You will work in a global environment that provides you with developmental opportunities both professionally and personally. We at Volvo Group want you to prosper and be happy, because when you succeed, we succeed. Together we drive prosperity. We are eager to learn from you and you will get fantastic opportunities to learn and develop with us.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

title: Manufacturing Strategy Manager
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Our world is a world of change

Our organization is built by people and great teamwork. We are a truly global company, and we believe in the advantage of diversity and together we create a workplace that brings the best out of everyone.

We believe in a sustainable future and with the global Transport industry as our arena, we work together with our customers to turn this belief into reality for people everywhere. That is our purpose, and we live and breathe it, every day.

Manufacturing Engineering in COTE encompasses the production of state-of-the-art products for the truck brands of the Volvo Group. Within manufacturing you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust and embrace change to stay ahead.

We are now looking for a Manufacturing Strategy Manager (MSM) Product Strategy & Preparation (PSP) team.

PSP Strategy team consists of 10 highly engaged colleagues situated in Sweden, France, Belgium, India, and USA. Our target is to secure and develop the manufacturing process globally covering Europe, Asia, and America.

We define and drive strategies for both products and processes to improve the quality, efficiency, and flexibility. We are expected to comprehend the growing competence needs and support/develop the products and processes to ensure the organizations success. Our focus is both on existing product and processes and on Industry 4.0 and the new technologies related to Electromobility and Vehicle Automation.

As an MSM you will have a global role and work in a multibrand and multicultural environment, you will be part of a global team responsible for defining, developing, and implementing manufacturing strategies and visions within the Hardware Area.

To enable future technology transfers you will also be responsible for identifying/supporting Technology development initiatives both within COTE.

You will be part of a global and multicultural team where trust, curiosity and performance are important cornerstones.

Mission

    To be the manufacturing primary interface towards product development in the Agile structure covering the HW area.
    To be actively involved in the early phases of product technology development including Advanced Engineering projects and development of Product roadmaps.
    To secure global alignment of product technology and process roadmaps across the regions, mainly the North America Manufacturing, Europe and Brazil Manufacturing, and International Manufacturing.
    To support project managers in the creation and implementation of project prerequisites and driving requirements.
    To work in close cooperation with the Manufacturing Technology Managers and Specialists, supporting them in the development of new technologies and process visions.



Main activities and responsibilities

    Drive the development of manufacturing product-related strategies (e.g. Physical Modules, Marriage Points, Interfaces).
    Early phases and Advanced Engineering initiatives
    Concept evaluation and selection
    Support the development of the Product Platform by representing manufacturing in the creation of the Product strategies and roadmaps
    Define and develop project prerequisites and driving requirements.
    Represent manufacturing in the Sub Technology structures.
    Anchoring of product concepts regarding process with the three regions
    Provide input to technology roadmap based on identified business potentials.
    Provide technical solutions according to technology roadmap.
    Secure System and Tools requirements in early phases.

Experience and competence

    Engineering University degree or equivalent
    Proven knowledge in Truck Architecture and modularity
    Proven leadership and networking experience in a multi-cultural environment
    You have experience from driving change in a global environment
    Proven knowledge in Manufacturing processes
    Project Management experience
    Experience in VPS tools and practice
    As all documentation is in English, proficiency in the English language is required.

Personal Skills

As a Manufacturing Strategy Manager you are expected to be skilled in driving networks and work in teams. You take responsibility are creative, autonomous, and innovative. You have good communication skills and are generous and share knowledge.

You should have a drive to develop yourself and your surrounding within your area of expertise.

Ready for your next move?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? We are looking for talented, motivated people who want to grow, take on new challenges, and make a real contribution. If you’re looking for an opportunity where you can develop your skills, work with great people, and be part of an inspiring environment, we’d love to hear from you. Take the next step and explore your opportunities with us!

Please submit your application through the application link.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

title: Digitalization Project Manager for Manufacturing
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Digitalization Project Manager for Manufacturing, you will spend your day balancing strategic project leadership with hands-on technical implementation at the Finspang production site. You will work closely with production teams, AM engineers, site management, and global digitalization stakeholders to drive digital transformation initiatives that support production ramp-up and cost optimization. A key part of your role will be developing and executing a local digitalization roadmap while leading the implementation of critical shopfloor systems such as MES and SCADA. Your expertise will help bridge local operational needs with global strategies while building long-term digital capabilities within the manufacturing organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Lead end-to-end digitalization projects, ensuring delivery against budget, schedule, and quality objectives
    Develop and execute a site-specific digitalization roadmap aligned with business priorities and global strategies
    Define project scopes, deliverables, and success metrics in collaboration with engineering teams and key stakeholders
    Monitor project progress, manage risks, and provide clear status reporting to leadership and stakeholders
    Drive the implementation of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and SCADA capabilities within the Additive Manufacturing environment
    Analyze manufacturing workflows and implement digitalization, automation, and process improvement opportunities

What You Bring

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Manufacturing Technology, or a related technical field
    Significant experience in project management within manufacturing, production, industrial engineering, or industrial digitalization environments
    Proven success in leading digital transformation, process improvement, automation, MES, SCADA, or other shopfloor IT system implementation projects
    Strong technical knowledge of manufacturing processes, smart factory technologies, workflow management, process development, and Lean Manufacturing principles
    Experience in Additive Manufacturing, advanced production technologies, or Industry 4.0 environments considered a strong advantage
    Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, analytical, troubleshooting, and change management skills with the ability to build organizational capabilities and drive business impact

About the Team
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 304123 not later than 2026-10-12.

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

title: Mättekniker
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:





Vill du vara med och säkerställa kvaliteten bakom produkter som används världen över?







Som Mättekniker blir du specialist inom avancerad mätteknik, kalibrering och kvalitetssäkring. Du spelar en viktig roll i att säkerställa att våra produkter uppfyller högt ställda krav på kvalitet och precision.







Bli en del av vårt teamDu blir en del av SHEQ-organisationen inom PQ och arbetar nära produktion, produktionsteknik, operatörer, konstruktörer, produktchefer, kvalitetsingenjörer samt externa leverantörer och systerbolag inom Epiroc. Rollen fungerar som ett specialiststöd inom mätteknik och bidrar till att utveckla både arbetssätt och kompetens inom området.







Du får en strukturerad introduktion med fokus på produktkännedom, mätprogrammering och avancerad mätteknik. Stöd från erfarna kollegor ger dig goda möjligheter att utvecklas långsiktigt inom specialistområdet.







Ditt uppdragSom Mättekniker ansvarar du för avancerad mätning, analys och verifiering av produkter och komponenter. Du arbetar både operativt och utvecklingsinriktat med att förbättra metoder, rutiner och mätprocesser.







Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar att:








    Utveckla, programmera och underhålla mätprogram samt arbeta med CAD- och 3D-modeller för implementering i mätutrustning.
    Genomföra avancerade mätningar med koordinatmätmaskiner och annan mätutrustning samt kalibrera och säkerställa funktion hos mätverktyg.
    Säkerställa att produkter uppfyller ritningskrav, toleranser och specifikationer samt analysera och rapportera mätresultat.
    Stödja produktionen vid kvalitetsfrågor, avvikelser och nya produkter samt bidra med mätteknisk expertis i förbättringsarbete, projekt och utveckling av metoder och rutiner.







Din profilVi tror att du trivs i en roll där du kombinerar analytiskt tänkande med ett strukturerat och noggrant arbetssätt. Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och har lätt för att samarbeta med personer från olika delar av verksamheten. Samtidigt är du självgående och bekväm med att driva ditt arbete framåt.







För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du sannolikt har:



Krav




    Erfarenhet av mätteknik, toleranser, kvalitetskontroll eller närliggande tekniskt område.
    God förmåga att läsa och tolka tekniska ritningar.
    Vana att arbeta i tekniska system och digitala verktyg.
    Svenska i tal och skrift.
    Relevant teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet från tillverkande industri.  







Meriterande




    Erfarenhet av koordinatmätmaskiner (CMM) eller annan avancerad mätutrustning.
    Erfarenhet av mätprogrammering, kalibrering eller analys av mätdata.
    Kunskaper inom CAD och arbete med 3D-geometrier.
    Kunskap inom produktionsteknik, maskinbearbetning eller värmebehandling.
    Kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift.  







Vi vet att starka kandidater inte alltid uppfyller varje enskilt krav. Om rollen väcker ditt intresse och du tror att din erfarenhet kan bidra till vår framgång uppmuntrar vi dig att söka.







Placering Denna tjänst är placerad i Fagersta.







Livet på EpirocNär du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation.







Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:




    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.  







Ansökan och kontaktinformationVi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 19 oktober 2026.  Ansökningar granskas löpande. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.







För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta anställande chef, Ingrid Bengtsson, SHEQ-Manager, ingrid.bengtsson@epiroc.com. Frågor om rekryteringsprocessen: Otto Wetterström, Rekryteringsspecialist, otto.wetterstrom@external.epiroc.com

title: Cloud Platform Engineer – Swedbank
description:
In this role, you will help build and evolve the foundation for secure cloud adoption across Swedbank. You will work with cloud technologies, automation and platform engineering practices that enable teams to innovate safely and efficiently in Azure and AWS.

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

    

Contribute to Azure and AWS Landing Zones, providing engineering teams with well-governed self-service capabilities that balance efficient delivery, security and compliance.

    

Design, deploy and operate cloud platform capabilities with a focus on reliability, scalability, security and compliance by design.

    

Enable internal engineering teams through platform services, automation and developer-friendly self-service experiences.

    

Contribute ideas, question existing approaches respectfully and help us continuously improve how we work.

    

Explore how automation and AI can support cloud engineering and improve the developer experience.

What is needed in this role:

    

Practical experience with Azure, AWS or another major cloud platform, together with an interest in developing knowledge of Azure and AWS.

    

Hands-on experience with Terraform or comparable Infrastructure as Code tooling.

title: Senior Business Controller
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

As a Senior Business Controller, you will be part of a global Business Control team supporting Cab Over Trucks Engineering (COT Eng), the largest R&D function within Volvo Trucks Technology & Industrial Division. You will report directly to the Head of COT Engineering Business Control.

In this role, you will act as a trusted business partner to the Heads of COT Engineering departments, supporting an organization in which both resource and product ownership are important dimensions. You will work with resource balancing and forecasting, drive efficiency, strengthen cost control, and ensure compliance with financial rules and policies. You will also provide financial insights that enable informed and sustainable decision-making within R&D.

Strong communication and collaboration skills are essential, as you will work with stakeholders at different levels across the organization. You should have an open and positive mindset, proactively identify improvement opportunities, and enjoy driving change. As a collaborative team player, you enjoy supporting colleagues and contributing to the success of the wider team.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Ensuring accurate and timely month-end and year-end closing
    Acting as the main Finance contact for the supported Engineering departments
    Managing forecasts and monitoring R&D expenses and project costs
    Providing financial analysis, insights, and business support to Engineering functions
    Performing financial due diligence on CAPEX-related business cases
    Supporting intercompany invoicing processes
    Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes, efficiency, and decision support

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

     A relevant university degree in Finance, Economics, or Business Administration
    A minimum of five years’ experience as a Business Controller or in a similar finance role
    Strong Excel skills; experience with Power BI is an advantage
    Strong digital literacy, with an interest in and aptitude for working with IT tools and financial systems, such as SAP
    Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken

What we offer

You will join a global and collaborative team with the opportunity to work closely with Engineering leadership and influence financial and operational decision-making in a complex R&D environment. The role offers broad exposure, a strong business-partnering dimension, and opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement across Engineering and Finance.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Who we are and what we believe in

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.

Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Director of Partner Acquisition
description:
About Gridheart

Gridheart AB is a leading Nordic distributor of cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity solutions. We enable Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to grow their businesses by providing them with best-in-class technology platforms, vendor partnerships, and go-to-market support. Our operations span seven countries: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Iceland, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.

Headquartered in Kista, Stockholm, we work closely with market-leading vendors including Acronis, and serve a growing network of MSP partners across Northern Europe.

About the Role

We are looking for a Director of Partner Acquisition to lead our efforts in identifying, recruiting, and onboarding new MSP partners across our markets. This is a senior commercial role with full ownership of the partner acquisition pipeline, from first contact through to signed agreement and early activation.

You will report directly to the CEO and play a central role in driving Gridheart's growth strategy. The position is based at our headquarters in Kista, Stockholm, and work will be carried out from the office with regular travel across the Nordic and UK markets.

Key Responsibilities

•         Develop and execute a scalable partner acquisition strategy across the Nordics, UK, and Ireland

•         Own the full pipeline from prospecting and outreach to contract signing and partner activation

•         Identify and engage prospective MSP partners through direct outreach, networking, and industry events

•         Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at target companies (CEOs, CTOs, business development leads)

•         Collaborate with marketing and technical teams to develop compelling value propositions and sales materials

•         Represent Gridheart at industry conferences, trade shows, and partner events

•         Report pipeline progress, conversion metrics, and market insights to the leadership team

•         Work closely with the partner management team to ensure smooth handover and successful onboarding of new partners

Qualifications and Requirements

Required:

•         Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B sales, channel sales, or partner/business development within the IT or technology sector

•         Proven track record of building and managing a partner or reseller pipeline

•         Strong understanding of the MSP/cloud/cybersecurity market landscape

•         Experience working across multiple countries or regions

•         Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

•         Fluent in English (written and spoken)

•         University degree or equivalent professional experience

•         Willingness to travel regularly across the Nordics and UK/Ireland

Desirable:

•         Experience from the Nordic IT channel or distribution market

•         Existing network of MSP contacts in the Nordics and UK

•         Proficiency in one or more Scandinavian languages

•         Experience with vendor programmes from companies such as Acronis, Microsoft, or similar

•         Familiarity with cloud marketplaces and subscription-based business models

title: Product Cost Specialist - Operations, Lund
description:
If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! We are growing and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist to join our team within Manufacturing Capacity and Cost.

Who is your future team?
Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.

Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.

This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.

What you'll do here as Product Cost Specialist

    Be responsible for negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.
    Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.
    Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.
    Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.
    Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.
    Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.
    Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.
    The position will mean some travels abroad.

You have:

    A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.
    Minimum 5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience from international manufacturing companies.
    Proven record of at least 2 years of business negotiations.
    Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.
    Excellent MS Office skills.
    Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.

It's good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:
Axis Career Hub
Life at Axis blog  
Engineering at Axis blog
Innovation at Axis

Ready to Act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!

title: Primary School Learning Assistant
description:
Reports to: Primary School Vice Principal

Our vision

To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.

Our mission

Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.

Description/Purpose

To support excellent education for primary school students from early years through grade 5. Working hours 40 hours per week, excluding half an hour lunch break.

Duties/Responsibilities

Classroom Responsibilities (8.30-15.30)

    Provide instructional support for the classroom teacher.
    Encourage student engagement and participation.
    Offer help and individual attention to students who need support.
    Lead small group discussions and/or activities.
    Give feedback to the classroom teacher regarding students' learning.
    Assist in keeping the general class organized.
    Be an active and contributing member of the School Faculty.
    Actively contribute to the operational needs of the school.
    To undertake duties as required, including before-school and end-of-day duties, break duties, lunch support, and additional support in other year groups as required.
    Foster a supportive and inclusive classroom environment.
    Substitute for the class teacher when the teacher is not in school (Remunerated with the initial teacher salary rate for those hours).

After-School Care / After-School Activities Duties (15:30-16:30/17:30 )

    Encourage student engagement and participation.
    Offer help and individual attention to students in need.
    Lead small group discussions and/or activities.
    Assist in keeping the general classroom environment in order.
    Foster a supportive and inclusive classroom environment.

Other Duties

    Greeting students and parents as they arrive at school.
    Monitoring students and ensuring their safety.
    Escorting students into the school in the crosswalk.
    Ensuring corridors are calm and students are in the correct location.

Break/Lunch Duties

    Collecting students from the corridor, as required.
    Monitoring students and ensuring their safety.
    Helping the play leaders with their duties, as required.
    Ensuring students exit the building calmly and quietly.

Traffic Duties

    Monitoring traffic flow and keeping the crossing paths clear of parked vehicles.

    Greeting students and parents as they leave school.

Qualifications, Attributes, and Experience

    The ability to work effectively in a team.
    A pleasant and friendly personality.

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. Individually negotiated.

title: Sourcing Manager - Logistics
description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.



Your opportunity

At Boliden, we believe that great results are created through collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement. Guided by our values of Care, Courage, and Responsibility, we work together to create a sustainable future. As a Sourcing Manager – Logistics, you will contribute to the development of Boliden's transport and logistics network, working closely with colleagues and suppliers across Europe and supporting logistics activities connected to Boliden's operational sites and business locations.

This role combines commercial thinking, relationship building, and analytical skills to create efficient and sustainable logistics solutions. Whether your background is in sourcing, logistics, supply chain, procurement, or a related field, you will have the opportunity to develop your expertise in an international environment and support Boliden's long-term ambitions.

We offer a collaborative environment where your contribution will have a direct impact on future generations. Together, we are working towards our vision of becoming the world's most sustainable and respected metal supplier.



Who you will work with

You will report to the Head of Logistics and be part of a team of seven dedicated logistics professionals within Group Logistics. In this role, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across Boliden’s organization, as well as with external logistics providers and strategic partners.

The position is preferably based in Sweden or Finland at one of our operational sites. Regular travel to Boliden sites will be required, along with occasional visits to other company locations.



What you will do

Boliden manages a large and complex logistics network involving the transportation of products, raw materials, by-products, and project cargo across multiple locations and transport modes.

As a Sourcing Manager – Logistics, you will be responsible for selected transport categories and logistics solutions across the Boliden Group, supporting flows to, from, and between Boliden's operations.

In this role, you will:

    Lead sourcing activities, tenders, and contract negotiations for transport and logistics services.
    Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics providers, suppliers, and strategic partners.
    Monitor transport markets and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, service, and sustainability.
    Drive initiatives related to safety, sustainability, quality, and continuous improvement across logistics flows.
    Support logistics projects, including network optimization, transport mode selection, and supply chain development.
    Collaborate with stakeholders across the business and follow up supplier performance through KPIs and business reviews.
    Contribute to emissions reduction, responsible sourcing, risk management, and the development of Group Logistics strategies and processes.
    Travel regularly as part of the role, approximately 2-4 days per month.



What you bring

You have experience working with sourcing, procurement, supplier management, logistics, supply chain, or a related business area and are motivated by building relationships and creating business value. We are open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience and believe this role can be an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take the next step in their career.

We place great importance on personal qualities. You are curious, proactive, and motivated to learn. You enjoy building networks and collaborating with stakeholders across different functions and cultures. You work in a structured manner, manage changing priorities effectively, and have the confidence to make well-founded decisions based on facts and analysis. You demonstrate integrity, take responsibility for your actions, and act as a role model in ethical matters.

We believe you have:

    A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or a related field. Relevant vocational education (YH) and/or practical experience are also considered valuable.
    Strong analytical skills and an interest in data-driven decision-making.
    An interest in supplier management, sourcing, negotiations, and logistics.
    Fluent English skills, both written and spoken. Proficiency in Finnish and an additional Nordic language is considered an asset.
    A valid EU Category B driving licence, as the role involves regular travel to Boliden's sites.





Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.



Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.



Want to know more about the position?

Contact hiring manager, Alexander Lindfors, Alexander.Lindfors@boliden.com.

title: Associate Senior Lecturer in Cybersecurity
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

Luleå University of Technology is currently in a phase of expansion and is undertaking an initiative to strengthen research and education in cybersecurity by establishing a new research group in the field. This initiative builds upon the university's successful computer science environment—which includes several strong research groups—offering excellent opportunities for synergy. We therefore place great importance on research and the development of methods to protect various types of Internet-connected systems. These systems range from small sensors to large-scale control systems, such as those used for critical infrastructure. The research spans the spectrum from in-depth technical studies to applied research conducted in collaboration with industry and society.

The cybersecurity group at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering, Luleå University of Technology, is now seeking an Associate Senior Lecturer to contribute to our activities.

Subject description

Cyber Security focuses on technical security aspects as well as protection of systems that are connected to the Internet and include protection of software, data, and hardware.

Duties

As an Associate Senior Lecturer, you will be involved in the university's education—particularly our newly launched Master's programme in cybersecurity, but also undergraduate and doctoral-level courses where applicable. In addition, the role includes pedagogical development and research within one or more of our profile areas: AI security, memory-safe programming, cloud security, OT security, blockchain applications, security and resilience in 5G/6G networks, and security culture and innovation, based on your own research interests and ongoing research projects.

Qualifications

To meet the requirements for the appointment as associate senior lecturer, the applicant:

    must have been awarded a doctoral degree or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree.

Primary consideration should be given to someone who has been awarded a doctoral degree within five years of the application deadline for employment as an associate senior lecturer. However, someone who has been awarded a doctoral degree or achieved corresponding competence at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds. Special grounds are sick leave, parental leave or other similar circumstances.

Assessment criteria

The following assessment criteria apply to this position:

    scientific expertise
    other assessment criteria.

Other assessment criteria:

    the degree of expertise required for qualification
    administrative proficiency that is of value in view of the subject matter and the duties included in the appointment
    the ability to collaborate with the wider community
    the ability to communicate research and development work
    the ability to teach in Swedish within a maximum of three years (the university offers language training if needed)
    doctoral degree obtained no more than five years prior to the application deadline

Currently, the majority of employees within the subject Cybersecurity are men and therefore we encourage applications from women.

In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.

Period of employment

For this employment, an employment period of four years applies.

Promotion to senior lecturer

An associate senior lecturer shall, upon application, be promoted to senior lecturer and a position until further notice. If the applicant is qualified for a position as senior lecturer and in an examination is deemed suitable for such a position, is determined in accordance with the assessment criteria set out below:

In the examination, it is required that the associate senior lecturer has completed higher education pedagogical education corresponding to 7.5 credits or has acquired corresponding knowledge in another way.

During the employment period, the associate senior lecturer must also independently, to a considerable extent and with high quality, contribute to the university's research and demonstrate good pedagogical skills.

title: Postdoc in industrial systems with a specialization in automation
description:
The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Engineering Sciences brings together a large part of the University’s Bachelor of Science in Engineering and Master of Science in Engineering programmes in fields such as energy engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, building engineering, environmental engineering and industrial systems. The department conducts internationally recognised research focusing on future energy and industrial systems. Collaboration with industry and society is central to developing sustainable, resource-efficient and competitive solutions for the society of tomorrow.

Employment information





Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years



Period of employment/Start date: As agreed



Scope: Full time



Number of positions: 1



Closing date for application: 26 october 2026



Campus location: Eskilstuna



School: Teknikvetenskap



Position description

The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years.

The position consists mainly of research in which the candidate is expected to independently plan and carry out scientific studies in the area of smart and portable automation. The position will be conducted within the framework of the research profile MARC (Mälardalen Research and Competence Centre for Future Manufacturing), which means that the work will take place in close collaboration with industry partners and other researchers within the profile.

Within MARC, the research focuses on future sustainable and flexible production systems, where smart and portable automation plays a central role. The candidate is expected to contribute to the development of new methods, technologies, and prototypes for portable and reconfigurable automation, as well as explore how these solutions can be integrated into industrial environments with requirements for flexibility, quality, and resource efficiency. The work may include experimental research in laboratory and industrial settings, system development, analysis of production flows, and co-creation of knowledge together with company partners. As MARC is a collaborative profile with strong ties to regional companies, the candidate will also take part in project meetings, workshops, and joint activities where industrial relevance and implementability are key components.

The postdoctoral position includes scientific writing of articles, dissemination, and oral presentation of research results. An important part of the dissemination work is active engagement in industrial applications in close collaboration with industrial partners.

As a postdoctoral researcher, you are expected to take responsibility for independently planning and conducting your studies, take initiatives to develop your ideas and knowledge, and cooperate with others both within and outside academia. Teaching or other departmental duties may be included up to a maximum of 20%.

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will also be part of the research group for Production Development, where you are expected to contribute to the development of the group.

title: Master Thesis: Recycled aluminium in battery casing application – microstru
description:
This master thesis is part of the Net Zero Impact Innovation-funded BAALSCRAP project (BAttery casings from ALuminum alloys with low carbon emissions produced from SCRAP), which aims to enable the production of battery cell housings from recycled aluminum scrap and thereby support the transition towards a circular and net-zero automotive industry. The project investigates how alloying elements and impurities originating from recycled feedstock affect manufacturing processes and material performance.

The thesis will focus on the relationship between microstructure and weld properties of recycled aluminum alloys for battery casing applications. The work will involve detailed characterization of welds using light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM), with emphasis on precipitates, intermetallic particles, segregation, porosity, cracking, and other welding-related defects. The influence of recycled alloying elements and residual impurities on weld quality and performance will be assessed and correlated with material properties. In addition, property calculations (e.g. crack susceptibility) will be used to predict weld performance as a function of alloy composition. The modeling results will be compared with the experimental observations to improve the understanding of microstructure evolution during welding and to help explain the relationship between alloy chemistry, weld microstructure, and weld performance.

Desired Qualifications
We are looking for a highly motivated Master's student in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Materials Engineering, or a related field. The ideal candidate has an interest in experimental research and materials characterization, with a particular focus on microstructure-property relationships in metallic materials. Experience or coursework in microscopy, welding metallurgy, aluminum alloys, or electron microscopy is advantageous but not required.

Additional Information
The project is planned to be carried out during the spring semester of 2027 at Swerim in Stockholm. Upon successful completion of the Master's thesis (30 ECTS credits), Swerim will provide a compensation of SEK 50,000.

title: Learning & Development specialist
employer: Who Collaborating Centre For Int Drug Monitoring
description:
Would you like to contribute to the safe use of medicines and vaccines globally? We are looking for a Learning & Development specialist to join our Learning & Development section.

Since 1978, Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC) has been dedicated to developing, supporting, and expanding the field of pharmacovigilance science and practice.

As a World Health Organization (WHO) Collaborating Centre, we support work around the world to examine the potential adverse effects of medicines and vaccines and contribute to safer, more informed care of patients.

We are a diverse, international group of pharmacists, physicians, data scientists, system developers, communicators, and many other professionals motivated by a deep belief that the work we do matters.

About the role

The Learning & Development section is part of UMC’s Communications & Learning department and is responsible for designing and developing online courses and overarching learning concepts. The section develops frameworks and structures to ensure alignment, continuous maintenance, and evaluation of learning initiatives. Through our Learning Management System (LMS), we offer courses designed for both a broad global audience and specific groups, including members of the WHO Programme for International Drug Monitoring (WHO PIDM) and users of UMC products.

We are seeking someone who can translate complex information into clear, engaging, and accessible learning content. You are skilled in digital learning tools, instructional design principles, and LMS management, and you bring both structure and creativity to your work. You have the ability to develop training concepts and learning paths grounded in the needs expressed by the business areas. With a collaborative mindset and strong organisational skills, you confidently manage multiple learning initiatives at the same time. You are also comfortable presenting and facilitating workshops.

You will report to the Head of Learning & Development section.

What you will do

    Design and develop online learning modules based on best practices in instructional design and adult learning theories
    Administer and manage the LMS, including uploading courses, tracking progress and generating reports
    Provide technical support for online learning throughout course life cycles
    Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) when developing learning content
    Apply instructional design principles to ensure learning content is pedagogically sound, engaging, and aligned with organisational goals
    Develop and deliver standardised presentations and learning materials for cross-functional use
    Deliver and facilitate organisation-wide face-to-face workshops and courses

Who you are

    University degree in instructional design, educational technology or similar
    A background in the life sciences, healthcare or similar is a plus
    Creative with strong ability to translate complex information into clear and engaging learning content
    Skilled in using Articulate 360 or similar e-learning authoring tools
    Skilled in applying instructional design principles
    Basic graphic design skills or familiarity with tools like Photoshop or Canva are an advantage
    Experienced with LMS administration
    Structured, organized, and able to manage multiple learning initiatives simultaneously
    Collaborative and confident working with SMEs
    Solution-oriented with the ability to turn needs into concrete learning experiences and training concepts.
    Comfortable presenting and facilitating workshops for diverse audiences
    Fluent in written and spoken English
    Additional language skills are a plus

Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC) is an independent, self-funded, non-profit foundation established in 1978 dedicated to safer use of medicines and vaccines. Through an agreement between the Government of Sweden and the World Health Organization (WHO), UMC operates the Programme for International Drug Monitoring, supporting over 180 member countries and regions in strengthening safety surveillance, and maintains VigiBase, the WHO global database of adverse event reports. In addition, UMC provides international standards and related digital solutions for secure exchange of pharmacovigilance data, including a global medicine and vaccine terminology for identification of medicinal products. With around 200 staff, UMC advances the science of pharmacovigilance and transforms its practice through technological innovation.

UMC’s working language is English. We normally apply a probationary period to new appointments.

title: Data Scientist - Anti-cheat
description:
The Anti-cheat team at Embark is responsible for upholding the integrity of our games, identifying instances of unfair play, and protecting the experience of our players. We have a versatile toolbox at our disposal, which we continuously evolve and refine, including client-side protections, third-party systems, machine-learning models. Being a core function supporting all of Embark games, we collaborate with many different stakeholders throughout the organisation, such as game teams, legal and community management.

We are now looking for a well rounded Data scientist to strengthen our operational capacity. As a member of our Anti-cheat team you will, among other things, be responsible for supporting our game teams with investigations into suspicious activities, performance analyses of detection rules, exploration of data and player behavior to design new rules. Your statistical background helps you identify significant patterns, and separate signals from noise. We operate in a complex environment where billions of telemetry events and other data are collected each day from all our games.

You are likely curious to continuously learn new skills. You enjoy working autonomously and taking initiatives, while also collaborating within and across teams. You have a passion for data and technology, and feel excited to use your skills to help protect our players from unfair play and malicious actors. By being creative and experimental you aim to solve problems in a game-changing way.

Example of responsibilities

    

Perform ad-hoc investigations into suspicious patterns and gameplay behavior

    

Work with game teams and customer support to verify and explain rule detections

    

Support our Esport event teams with vetting of contestants

    

Provide reports and performance analyses of our anti-cheat operation

We would love if you have

    

A creative and curious mind.

    

Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with database querying, preferably using tools such as BigQuery

    

Proficiency in Python.

    

Experience working with Google Cloud Platform.

    

Experience working with ETLs and data pipelines.

    

Experience in predictive modeling and analysis over large datasets

    

Professional English communication skills.

    

Experience and/or interest in games and anti-cheat will be considered a bonus!

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

We welcome game makers of all sex, class, colour, age, gender identity, education, religion, opinion, culture, nation of origin, language, sexual orientation, shape, size, and ability.

Did we leave anyone out? Well, we welcome you, too! We think that the gaming industry is made better when everyone has a seat at the table.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

Det är meriterande om du har:
